jobs.title: (Senior) Product Manager | Full Time (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Who Are We ? 
 🚧 Picture logistics that run like clockwork – fast, smart, and seamless. 
 Autonomous logistics does not start with self-driving trucks. It starts with CONROO.
 At CONROO, we are building an intelligent infrastructure that drives terminals and depots towards autonomy by connecting truck drivers, terminals, and depots through continuous data flows. We replace manual and paper-based processes with real-time, data-driven workflows, turning chaos into connected systems and making truck handling fully digital.
 Every step we automate today lays the foundation for terminals and depots to operate autonomously tomorrow.
 We are CONROO and we are driving logistics to autonomy. 
 💼 About This Role 
 As a (Senior) Product Manager at CONROO, you'll be one of the people steering where our product goes next. You'll spend time with customers and stakeholders to really understand what they need, then turn that into requirements the team can actually build from. You'll work closely with our developers day to day, answering questions, and making calls when priorities need to shift. It’s a role with real ownership, where your decisions matter and you can see their impact directly in the product.
 🎖 What Success Looks Like 
 In your first month 
 You become familiar with the company, product, development process, customers, and key business areas and projects.

 You work closely with Tech, Sales, and other teams to understand customer needs, business objectives, and product priorities.

 You join Scrum ceremonies and observe how requirements and priorities are managed.

 You align and guide a cross-functional team. Setting clear priorities, offering direction, and helping people do their best work.

 By 3 months 
 You analyse and manage project requirements and stakeholder demands.

 You independently create, prioritize, and maintain the product backlog based on customer needs and business objectives.

 You take ownership of user stories, acceptance criteria, and product requirements.

 You take an active role in Scrum management and coordination.

 You work with the relevant team members to ensure our product meets UX standards, quality standards, and relevant regulatory requirements.

 You will communicate product vision, goals, priorities, and progress to internal and external stakeholders.

 You communicate directly with customers and stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into actionable requirements.

 You will have ownership of assigned projects and topics and manage them with increasing autonomy.

 By 6 months 
 You independently manage projects and requirements from initial stage through implementation.

 You have ownership of Scrum processes and ensure effective collaboration and communication across teams.

 You proactively identify customer needs, product opportunities, risks, and areas for improvement.

 You contribute significantly to product development and prioritisation.

 You consistently improve project management, requirements management, and quality processes where needed.

 You operate autonomously while keeping relevant stakeholders aligned and informed.

 You become the trusted point of contact for product-related topics across Tech, Sales, and other teams.

 🚀 What You Need to Be Successful 
 You have a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Business Informatics, Information Technology, or a related field.

 You bring several years of experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager, ideally in a SaaS environment.

 You have experience working with SCRUM and agile development processes.

 You have experience in specifying requirements and developing user and technical stories.

 You possess a solid understanding of technology, software development, and digital products.

 You quickly grasp complex processes & technical requirements allowing you to create tailored solutions that deliver value for both clients and the business.

 You bring strong communication skills and are confident working with a wide range of stakeholders, from C-level executives and internal teams to customers.

 You bring strong organizational skills and are comfortable managing and prioritizing multiple requirements.

 You are fluent in German and English, both written and spoken.

 This role is based in our Munich or Nuremberg office, with at least 3 days per week on site.
 ⚙️ Must Have Tools & Technologies 
 You have experience working with Jira or similar project management tools.

 You are familiar with Figma or similar design and collaboration tools.

 You have experience working with CRM systems.

 💡It’s a Plus If You Have 
 Previous experience in the logistics industry.

 Experience working in a startup or scale-up environment.

 🌟 How We Set You Up to Be Successful 
 At CONROO, we don’t just define what success looks like – we actively support you in getting there through a structured, hands-on onboarding process during your first six months with us.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Finance Engineering
jobs.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us to redefine the future of on-demand delivery. To do this, we're building a world-class Finance Engineering (FinEng) organization across all global markets we support at DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt. in which each of our product managers plays a critical role in helping to define and execute our vision to move money accurately and at scale across every market we operate in and ensure finance and accounting compliance. As we grow, billions of dollars in money movements flow through our platform every year and our team makes sure every one of them is understood, trusted, and correctly reflected in the financial books.

About the Role

Product Managers on the Finance Engineering team need a systems-oriented mindset, platform thinking, and strong cross-functional collaboration. In this role, you will define the strategy and vision for systems that track billions of dollars in company-wide money movement, translate transactions into accounting entries, and accelerate the financial close. You will build scalable, audit-ready automation for complex, high-volume financial activity.

This is an opportunity to reshape modern accounting by applying AI to reconciliation, investigations, and incident detection and mitigation. Your products will form a critical part of the company’s financial infrastructure and help earn the confidence of leadership, auditors, and regulators.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Drive the product definition, strategy, and long-term vision for accounting automation. You own the roadmap
  • Build systems that track billion-dollar-level money movements across the entire company and automatically convert them into accurate accounting entries
  • Reinvent and accelerate the accounting close process, reducing manual effort and shortening close timelines
  • Champion AI-driven approaches to transform close reconciliation, financial investigations, and incident detection and mitigation
  • Partner with FinEng, Accounting, and Finance leaders to translate complex financial and regulatory requirements into scalable, automated products
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams of engineers, designers, data scientists, accountants, and operators
  • Communicate product plans, benefits, and results to key stakeholders including the leadership team

We're excited about you because…

  • You have a track record in product management, including driving product strategy, vision, and roadmap alignment
  • You have built complex, back-end, data-intensive, or platform products. Ideally in fintech, payments, accounting, or financial systems
  • You have a strong grasp of accounting concepts (e.g. double-entry, ledgers, reconciliations, the close process) and how financial data flows through complex system
  • You do your best work with range: global platform thinking alongside the accounting reality of a specific brand or market
  • You're an execution power-house who thrives in ambiguity and operates at the lowest level of detai
  • You are excited about applying AI/ML to real-world financial problems such as reconciliation, investigation, and incident mitigation
  • You have experience presenting business reviews to senior executives
  • You have empathy for the users you build for, including accountants, controllers, and finance operators
  • You are motivated by building financial infrastructure that works across DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning. 💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you’re rewarded for the impact you make.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog. We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—ou

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Level Up Your Career! 

 

 At Kwalee, you’ll join a gaming powerhouse that boasts a mobile empire with 1.5 billion+ downloads alongside a thriving PC & Console division that has achieved numerous global chart-topping releases across Steam, Consoles, and Amazon, driving millions of Wishlists. Most recently publishing breakout hits such as The Precinct and Town to City. It’s a unique chance to bring your expertise to a global studio that dominates both the mobile, and the indie PC and Console space.

 

 At Kwalee, as well as a competitive salary we also offer; Private Medical Insurance, Dental Insurance, Life Assurance, Royal London Pension, a Free On-site Gym, Dog-friendly Office, LinkedIn Learning, 25 holiday days + bank holidays, and 1 day extra holiday for each year of service capped at 5.
 

 
 Join The Team! 

 Kwalee’s Product & Growth team is looking for a Senior Product Manager to shape what comes next in our live games: what we change, why, and what it will earn.

 You’ll team up with our Executive Producers: they lead how we build, you lead what we build and why, and together you make our games better and better. 

 We’ll match the title to your experience. This role is for you if you’re a product leader who loves living in player data, forming bold hypotheses about retention, engagement, and monetisation, running clean experiments, and turning results into confident decisions.

 
This role is based onsite 5 days per week at our Leamington Spa studio, where our daily in-office collaboration fuels creativity and innovation. 

 What You’ll Do: 
 

 Understand the games inside out. Know the key numbers for each game, find the biggest opportunities in retention, engagement, economy, and monetisation, and size them.

 Start with a hypothesis. Turn every opportunity into a clear hypothesis with a success metric, so every feature ships with a purpose.

 Run experiments that decide. Design A/B tests with our product analysts, read them with an open mind, and decide together with the producer what ships next.

 Shape the roadmap. Build and prioritise the game roadmap with the Executive Producer, ranked by the value it will create.

 Connect growth and product. Bring what UA and creative learn about our players into the games, and work with monetisation on the best player experience.

 Grow the product craft. Guide our product analysts and help set how we do product across the portfolio.

 Spot tomorrow’s hits. Bring a product view to our most promising new games as they grow.

 What You’ll Own: 
 
 Great product decisions and the extra player value that they will create in our biggest games.

 You’ll be the champion who ensures every big player opportunity gets a smart hypothesis, a clear experiment, and a place on the roadmap.

 How we’ll celebrate your success: 

 Growth in LTV and profit from product changes.

 Retention, engagement, and monetisation in your games.

 Experiments launched, learned from, and shipped.

 Clear, well-reasoned roadmap decisions.

 What We’re Looking For: 
 Essential 

 Senior product management experience in F2P mobile games, with live games you’ve measurably improved.

 Strong analytical skills: at home with cohorts, funnels, and experiment design; A great understanding of game economies, progression, LiveOps, and hybrid monetisation.

 A hypothesis-driven mindset: you know what you expect to happen, why, and what you’ll do if you’re wrong.

 Experience partnering closely with producers or game leads.

 A clear, warm communicator who makes the case to players and pounds.

 Desirable 

 SQL experience.

 Experience guiding or mentoring analysts.

 Puzzle or hybrid-casual mobile game experience.

 Why Kwalee? 

 
 Generous Holiday: Start with 25 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays. You'll also earn an extra day for every year of service, up to 5 years!

 Flexible Working: We offer core hours that allow you to work flexibly around your life, and a bank of 'Work From Home' days to use when you need them.

 Health Cover: Private medical cover, life assurance, a solid pension plan, and cover for dental and optical care.

 Recharge: Take advantage of our on-site gym and a supportive atmosphere that prioritises your wellbeing.

 Free Food & Drink: Fuel your day with unlimited free snacks and drinks.

 Gaming Goodies: Receive Steam codes for all our game releases!

 Dog-Friendly Office: Bring your furry friend to our vibrant, fun office.

 Office Location: Leamington Spa office location, with free parking and electric charging stations.

 Merch & Events: Get exclusive Kwalee merch, enjoy fun seasonal events, and stay informed with regular town halls.

 Growth & Learning: Full access to LinkedIn Learning to support your continuous professional development.

A travers le monde, nos solutions révolutionnent la façon dont nos client·e·s délivrent leurs produits aux personnes consommatrices finales. Nous contribuons au succès des plus grandes marques du commerce et de l’industrie, tout en améliorant les conditions de travail de leurs salarié·e·s.

 Missions

jobs.title: Product Manager, Developer Ecosystem
jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. Itâs built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internetâs largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

 About the Team 

 Reddit's developer ecosystem is one of the biggest opportunities to make Reddit more useful, expressive, extensible, and valuable. Today, most people who build on Reddit are developers: they write code, use Devvit, work with APIs, and ship apps or games through a relatively technical workflow. That ecosystem is growing quickly and remains critical.

 But the future is bigger than developers alone. AI-assisted building is changing who can create software. The next generation of Reddit apps, games, tools, community agents, content formats, and workflows should be buildable by many more people: developers, technically curious creators, moderators, community builders, game designers, data partners, and eventually people who can describe what they want without needing to code it by hand.

 The Developer Ecosystem team owns the product systems that help this broader set of builders discover opportunities, create successfully, launch high-quality apps and games, reach the right users and communities, adopt new platform capabilities, and keep improving after launch. This includes surfaces and systems like developers.reddit.com, AI-assisted creation, app review, developer and creator onboarding, app marketplace experiences, platform capabilities, best practices, and support for emerging creator categories.

 About the Role 

 We are looking for a Staff Product Manager to lead Reddit's Builder Ecosystem product strategy. This person will define the roadmap for how Reddit moves from a developer-only ecosystem to a broader builder ecosystem where AI-assisted and no-code creation become first-class parts of the platform.

 The role spans developer growth, creator onboarding, AI-assisted building, app quality, ecosystem incentives, platform capabilities, app marketplace strategy, operational tooling, feature adoption, and new builder categories.

 This is a high-ambiguity platform role with direct business, product, and community impact. The right PM will be able to bridge two worlds: they should understand the needs of serious developers and platform engineers, while also having strong conviction that Reddit can unlock a much larger wave of builders by making creation more accessible, guided, AI-native, and outcome-oriented.

 What You'll Do 

 
 Define the product strategy for Reddit's Developer Ecosystem, including the transition from code-first developers to a broader base of AI-assisted creators.

 Own the roadmap for developers.reddit.com as the primary builder portal, including onboarding, docs, app management, analytics, review status, feature access, education, examples, templates, and AI-assisted creation entry points.

 Lead strategy for AI-assisted app creation, including prompt-to-app workflows, AI building tools, no-code or low-code experiences, reusable templates, generated scaffolds, and systems that help creators turn ideas into useful Reddit-native apps.

 Build the product approach for an App Marketplace that helps users, moderators, communities, and internal teams discover high-quality apps, games, agents, tools, and community experiences.

 Improve app review and ecosystem operations through tooling, automation, and AI-assisted workflows, including LLM-powered app review, policy checks, quality signals, and reviewer efficiency.

 Partner with Engineering to prioritize core platform capabilities and performance improvements such as webhooks, webviews, APIs, SDKs, tooling, observability, and other primitives builders need to create reliable apps.

 Drive more successful, retentive, and popular apps and games by identifying best practices, improving templates, shaping incentives, and creating clearer paths from idea to launch to growth.

 Identify and support new creator and developer categories

 Partner with internal teams such as Contribution, Community Builders, Games, Search, Recommendations, Safety, and Ads to help them launch new functionality through the developer ecosystem.

 Define and improve feature adoption programs so builders understand, test, and successfully use new platform capabilities.

 Work with developer relations to establish the measurement system for the ecosystem, including weekly active developers/creators, NPS/CSAT, app launches, app retention and more

 Create clear frameworks for when Reddit should build platform primitives, launch templates, fund builders, partner with external teams, promote apps, or shut down low-quality or low-trust ecosystem behavior.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Platform (all genders)
jobs.description:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travelers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com.
 We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. Having grown 10x in the past year, we are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel. Backed by four leading VCs (TQ Ventures, Creandum, Northzone, and Lightrock), and now, following our recent $80 m Series C, we are ready to push beyond.

 The Opportunity 
 As a Product Manager in the Platform team, you own our established booking API, used by all our clients for booking and post-sales actions. You extend its functionality to match the market, build new capabilities on top of our wealth of data, and make the API as easy as possible to use and understand, so new clients can get started faster. 
 
 What you will do: 

 Product Ownership & Strategy: Own the product end-to-end, shaping its roadmap and priorities for booking and post-sales functionality, and working autonomously within the team’s direction. 

 API Evolution: Extend booking and post-sales capabilities to match market standards, and build new features on top of our established API. 

 Integration Experience: Make the API simple to understand and use, with clear contracts, documentation, and flows that shorten onboarding for new customers. 

 Complex Solution Design: Design end-to-end solutions across multiple systems and workflows, working with engineering on system design for high-load environments. 

 Quality & Reliability: Make sure the product is robust and error-resistant, with every relevant use case and edge case covered. 

 Data-Driven Initiatives: Use our booking data and research to find opportunities, shape strategic initiatives, and measure impact. 

 Stakeholder Alignment: Align retailers, carriers, engineering, commercial, and operations teams around clear priorities and outcomes. 

 
 Workplace: 
 We are mainly looking for this role to be based within Germany, preferably in our HQ in Berlin.
 We are a remote-first company, with teams located around the Globe and our HQ office in Berlin, where the team often meets in the office.

 
 Who you are: 
 2+ years of product management experience, with a strong focus on B2B and technical products. 

 Hands-on AI experience and the ambition to make it core to how you work, shipping faster without compromising quality.

 Proven experience owning API products end-to-end, from contract design to customer adoption. 

 Solid understanding of system design and high-load, transactional systems; able to discuss architecture trade-offs with engineers. 

 A track record of independently leading complex product initiatives with multiple stakeholders. 

 Strong attention to detail and design thinking, especially for complex workflows and edge cases. 

 A data-driven, impact-focused mindset, using data and research to shape decisions. 

 Excellent communication skills in English. 
 Nice to Have 

 Experience with ticket-selling, booking, or auction systems. 

 Background in travel, mobility, or marketplace platforms. 
 

 What you can expect: 
 You will join a fast-paced travel tech company and take on a rapidly growing industry.

 You will take on ownership and responsibility from day one and have a direct impact on the success of the company.

 We value agility! We’re constantly updating our tech stack and offer the best possible tools to ensure all of our in-house engineers, partners, and carriers benefit from cutting-edge, efficient solutions.

 You will work with global companies. Our product attracts the biggest names in travel technology, such as Booking.com, Google Maps, and national carriers like Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF.

 For Management positions: As part of the management team, you will shape our strategy and organization beyond your area of responsibility.

jobs.title: Lead Project Manager Dual Use In-Orbit Services
jobs.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.
 
At The Exploration Company, we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable orbital vehicle designed to carry cargo and, in the longer term, humans. Nyx is being developed with the capabilities required for safe, reliable and repeatable rendezvous, proximity operations and docking, including missions to the International Space Station.

 Building on this heritage, our Future Projects activities are developing new orbital services and spacecraft applications for institutional, commercial and defence customers. We are seeking an experienced Dual Use In-Orbit Services Project Manager to lead the complete development and delivery of orbiters for defence and dual-use applications.

 This is a high-impact role for an experienced spacecraft project manager who can translate customer needs into executable programmes and lead multidisciplinary teams from early concept and proposal phases through design, qualification, launch, commissioning and operations. The successful candidate will combine strong spacecraft engineering understanding with a proven record of delivering flight hardware and managing demanding institutional and defence stakeholders.

 Key Responsibilities

 In your capacity as Dual Use In-Orbit Services Project Manager, your role will be continuously evolving, but day-to-day your duties will include:

 Lead the complete development of orbiters and associated in-orbit service capabilities for defence and dual-use missions, from mission definition and early concept studies through qualification, launch, commissioning, flight and operations.

 Translate customer objectives and operational needs into clear mission, system and programme requirements.

 Establish and maintain the project baseline, including scope, schedule, budget, resources, technical performance and quality objectives.

 Define the project organisation, work breakdown structure, milestones, reviews and decision gates.

 Drive disciplined decision-making, issue resolution and change control throughout the project lifecycle.

 Ensure successful delivery against commitments in terms of technical performance, schedule, cost, quality and customer satisfaction.

 Monitor industrialisation, procurement, manufacturing and supply-chain activities, ensuring that critical path items and long-lead equipment are actively managed.

 Work closely with engineering and industrial teams to ensure the timely delivery of flight and ground hardware, software, documentation and operational products

 Act as the main point of contact for institutional and defence customers throughout the project lifecycle.

 Support and lead the preparation of proposals, responses to Invitations to Tender, Requests for Proposals and other business opportunities related to defence and dual-use in-orbit services.

 Coordinate and lead multidisciplinary teams across programme management, systems engineering, spacecraft engineering, operations, manufacturing, supply chain, quality and business functions.

 What We Would Love to See from You

 In the role of Dual Use In-Orbit Services Project Manager, ideally, you will have the following:
 Master’s degree in aerospace engineering.

 Typically 10 or more years of professional experience in the aerospace or space sector, including substantial responsibility for project or programme management and technical delivery.

 Proven experience leading the end-to-end development of satellites, orbiters, spacecraft or complex space systems.

 Demonstrated delivery of flight hardware, including experience through integration and test, qualification, launch preparation and/or in-orbit operations.

 Established customer-facing experience, ideally including direct interaction with DLR, the German Federal Ministry of Defence or comparable institutional and defence organisations.

 Skills and Behaviors

 Fluency in English and German.

 Strong oral and written communication skills

 Strong analysis and problem-solving skills

 Strong organizing and prioritization of tasks

 Positive and flexible attitude to get the job done

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Paris
jobs.description:
Who we are 
 
 Yubo is the instantly social, social app: the leading real-time social discovery platform where you can meet new people for friendship, crushes and community. Our mission is to help young adults find community - whoever they are, wherever they are and whenever they feel social. That's why we’re building a more spontaneous and human social world, one based on interaction, exploration and possibility.
 
 We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow. Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission.
 
 As the leading platform to socialize online, we have a special responsibility to build a safe digital space for our community. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education.
 
 We also work closely with the broader technology industry to share our knowledge and NGOs create industry-leading child protection standards.
 
 Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions!
 About this role
 
At Yubo, Product Managers have real ownership. They work in strong partnership with Product Designers and Engineering, shaping strategy and decisions from problem definition all the way to delivery, with direct and visible impact on both the product and the business.
 We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to form that partnership with a Product Designer: a duo jointly responsible for the end-to-end experiences you ship together. You'll take ownership of a strategic product area, identify the biggest opportunities, and turn them into clear product bets on a product used by millions of people.
 We're moving away from small, isolated feature launches toward bigger, end-to-end experiences tested at scale . You'll combine user understanding, data and strong product convictions to frame problems, shape solutions with Design and Engineering, and decide what to scale, iterate, or stop.
 You'll also work closely with Data, Machine Learning, Brand Marketing and Trust & Safety on challenges ranging from recommendation and discovery to retention, safety, monetization and AI.
 This role is particularly well suited to someone who enjoys balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and who wants their decisions to have a visible impact on both user experience and business outcomes.
 To make this dream duo work, we’re basing this role in Paris and looking for someone willing to come to the office once or twice a week.
 

 Your responsibilities
 Own a strategic product area from problem definition through delivery and post-launch iteration

 Define product strategy and translate company objectives into clear priorities and measurable outcomes

 Partner closely with Product Design and Engineering to shape end-to-end experiences rather than isolated features

 Use data, research, user feedback, market insights, and product intuition to identify the problems worth solving

 Turn opportunities into bold product bets, measure their impact, and decide whether to scale, iterate, or stop

 Collaborate with Data, Machine Learning, Brand Marketing, Trust & Safety, and Legal to make informed product decisions

 Balance user value, business impact, safety, and technical constraints when making trade-offs

 Create alignment across stakeholders through clear problem framing, strong product conviction, and structured decision-making

 AI tooling: Claude Code, ChatGPT Codex, Dust
 

 Who you are
 You have 4+ years of experience as a Product Manager, ideally within consumer mobile products and a startup or scale-up environment

 You are comfortable owning a product area from problem definition through launch and iteration

 You combine strong product intuition with analytical rigor

 You know how to use data, research, user feedback, and experimentation to guide decisions

 Understand current product priorities, ongoing experiment

jobs.title: Product Manager, Safety & Compliance
jobs.description:
Product Manager, Safety & Compliance 
 CreatorIQ is the software enterprise brands and agencies use to run their creator marketing programs. Customers include Burson, Delta Air Lines, Google, LVMH, Nestlé and Sephora. Those programs only hold up if the content is brand safe, sponsorships are disclosed, the music is cleared, and every campaign follows the rules in the markets it runs in. You'll own the product that makes that happen.
 The core is SafeIQ, our always-on brand safety system. It runs multimodal AI classification on audio, video, images and text across millions of creator posts, and flags risk before it becomes a headline.
 If you like turning messy classification and regulatory problems into workflows that risk, legal and compliance teams trust, you'll fit in. We're growing fast, and we work with teams around the world who care about doing great work.
 
 In this role, you’ll get to: 
 Own the in-app brand safety review and workflow experience end to end, with one goal: shorten the path from "AI flagged something" to "a human made a confident decision." Ship, measure, learn, repeat.

 Decide how AI classification reaches people: severity, categories, thresholds, review states and false-positive handling. Work with data science on what the models look for across audio, video, images and text, how confident they need to be before surfacing something, and where a human stays in the loop. Make every flag explainable and auditable.

 Own compliance beyond content risk: sponsorship and ad disclosure under FTC guidelines and their equivalents, music licensing and rights clearance, legal drinking age (LDA) rules for alcohol promotion, and GDPR and regional privacy requirements. Work with Legal, Trust & Safety and regional compliance stakeholders to stay ahead of regulatory change without making every workflow wait on a legal review.

 Understand the business nuance for API contracts, webhook payloads and data models with engineering so customers can pull safety and compliance signals into their own systems.

 Work with GTM on positioning, packaging and enablement so what we sell matches what the product does and what regulators require.
 

 Who you are and what you’ll need for this position: 
 You've spent 4+ years in product management or equivalent technical product ownership in B2B SaaS. 

 You have good product taste. You can look at an AI-generated feature or output and tell good UX from an AI slop, and you can say why.

 You think critically and independently. You don't take a model's output, a legal requirement, a stakeholder request or a roadmap item at face value.

 You can turn a dense, ambiguous regulatory or licensing requirement into a workflow engineers can build, and write it up clearly without needing a meeting.

 You know the basics of AI classification pipelines: inference, confidence thresholds, false positives and negatives, and human review. You don't have to build them.

 You're comfortable with API contracts, webhooks and role-based access well enough to write requirements with engineers.

 You care more about solving real user problems, like getting a risk team to zero backlog with confidence, than about shipping features for their own sake.

 You're curious, self-driven and low-ego. You own the product end to end, don't wait to be told what's next, and are allergic to "that's not my job."

 You're comfortable working with distributed teams. Most work is async and flexible, but occasionally we'll ask for a later call. Stakeholders for this role are distributed across NA, EU, and APAC timezones

 
 Nice to have: 
 Experience with trust and safety, content moderation, risk scoring or compliance tooling.

 Experience with multimodal AI, content classification or ML evaluation workflows.

 Experience with regulated content and privacy rules: FTC disclosure guidelines, music and content licensing, alcohol promotion, or GDPR and CCPA, and how they shape product requirements.

 Experience shipping customer-facing APIs, webhooks or enterprise integrations.

 Familiarity with social media platforms, martech or influencer workflows.

 
 Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. Have 50% of the criteria? Excited about this opportunity? Interested about what we do at CreatorIQ? Please apply!
  
 What you will get from us: 
 People: Work with talented, collaborative, and friendly people who love what they do.

 Guidance: Utilize our learning platform to fully get the training and tools you'll need to become successful here from your first day with us.

 Work/life harmony: 25 days of vacation, floating and company holidays, wellness benefits, and paid parental leave.

 Whole Health Package: Comprehensive healthcare coverage, including medical, dental, vision, mental health support, life insurance, income protection, and other wellness benefits.

 Planning for the future: A Royal London Pension Plan to help you plan ahead.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Financial Statement Suite
jobs.description:
Before a company publishes its annual report, finance teams have to turn financial data into a complete set of statements and disclosures. Balances need to be mapped, figures carried forward and updated, and supporting information brought together into a draft. Auditors then check that the notes match the primary statements, this year reconciles with last year, and every total adds up. Preparing and reviewing those statements takes days of detailed work, and errors can carry through into a published report.
 Today, audit teams rely on Financial Statement Suite (FSS) to read statements, run checks, and show reviewers what it found and where, so they can make the call and stand behind it. The opportunity goes beyond reconciliation: helping auditors and financial professionals review drafts, connect figures to supporting evidence, and manage changes through to sign-off.

Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.
 At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.
 For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.
 And we build at scale. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers . Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.
 If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way. 
  
 
 What impact you will have 
 Own the end-to-end strategy and decisions for our financial statements product, with clear domain ownership

 Reimagine how auditors and financial professionals work, making their workflows more defensible
 

 Why it's an exciting challenge 
 Reviewers are sceptical, and they should be. A finding they can't trace is a finding they check again by hand.

 Statements differ by country, by standard and by firm. FSS has to be right on all of them, not just the ones in front of you this week.

 Firms use FSS when the stakes are highest. Every change has to make their next busy season better, not riskier.

At Tandem, you'll drive how our platform connects with the external systems used across French and European healthcare - owning and driving some of the most critical technical initiatives we have. You'll be based in our France office, working alongside the local team, in close collaboration with our central Integrations team in Stockholm. A big part of the role is deeply understanding both sides: the capabilities and constraints of external systems, and those of our own platform. From that understanding, you'll find ways to integrate them and shape concrete proposals for how integrations should work, together with external partners.

You move fast, but not carelessly. You know how to break down complex problems, prioritize what matters, and keep momentum across multiple workstreams. You're comfortable going deep technically when needed, understanding APIs, data flows, and system constraints, while still keeping the bigger product picture in mind.
 
This is a high-impact role where you'll not only deliver projects, but shape how we build and scale technical products at Tandem.
 
 What You'll Do 
 Lead integration work with external partners and healthcare systems, ensuring high-quality, scalable implementations.

 Map external systems against our own platform and propose concrete integration designs to external partners.

 Act as the central point of coordination between engineering, partnerships, and external stakeholders, bridging the local team in France and the integrations team in Stockholm.

 Translate complex technical requirements into clear priorities, plans, and deliverables.

 Work closely with engineers to understand APIs, data models, and system architecture, and ensure solutions are robust and aligned with our platform.

 What You Bring

 Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams without losing clarity or momentum.

 Ability to anticipate, assess, and manage risk in projects, from scoping through to delivery.

 Strong communication skills, you can translate technical complexity into clear decisions and direction.

 The team: 

 
 You will join the Code Quality product team, part of Sonar's Product Management group. Each Code Quality PM works with dedicated engineering squads and partners closely with UX, marketing and sales. We value collaboration, kindness and continuous improvement, and we base decisions on data and customer evidence. 

 What will you own: 

 
 
 The strategy and roadmap to develop our language ecosystems, from market research and customer discovery to shipped rules and analyzers.

 
 Decisions on which new languages Sonar should support, and where we should not compete. 

 
 New AI capabilities: how our analysis fits into the workflows of AI coding agents, and how quality gates apply to AI-generated code. 

 
 Day-to-day trade-offs with analyzer engineers, such as rule precision versus noise, and analysis speed. 

 
 Regular contact with developers and customers through calls, our community forum and conferences, and turning what you learn into roadmap decisions. 

 

 What you will do 
 
 You’ll enjoy this role if you care about well-crafted software and like owning a topic end to end.

 

 
 Product vision and roadmap: research, clarify, and prioritize opportunities, and keep the roadmap effective

 
 Customer interaction: engage with users on the product forum, support them, and turn their feedback into opportunities

 
 Domain expertise: develop a deep understanding of code quality and how to help developers write more reliable, maintainable software

 
 Cross-team work: collaborate with other PMs on cross-product features, and align with engineering and UX from problem definition through development

 Experience and qualifications 
 
 Must-haves 

 
 5+ years in technical roles, ideally including hands-on software development. 

 
 3+ years as a product manager on a technical or B2B software product, owning discovery, strategy and roadmap rather than only the backlog, preferably in an agile environment. 

 
 Hands-on use of AI coding assistants or agents in your own work, and an informed view of how they are changing software development. 

 
 Proven ability to lead a topic autonomously from start to finish, making pragmatic decisions amid change, complexity and uncertainty. 

 
 Fluent written and spoken English. 

 Nice to have 

 
 Solid understanding of code quality in at least one programming language or ecosystem.

 Experience in developer tools, or contributions to open-source tooling such as linters, compilers or IDE plugins.

jobs.title: Analysis Experience Product Manager
jobs.description:
Who is Sonar? 

 Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com , Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 
 

 Position description 

 You will own the product vision and domain strategy for analysis experience, partnering with engineering and product leaders to align investment and delivery across teams.

 Your mission is to evolve existing report processing, storage, and APIs into a shared service, so teams can submit work, process findings, and retrieve reusable artifacts and evidence without rebuilding these capabilities independently. Shape the service around static and agentic workflows, with support for additional analysis types guided by validated customer needs.

 The domain covers issue-processing pipelines, durable storage, and supporting APIs and events. You will agree the scope and ownership of shared execution orchestration and other expanded capabilities with engine, infrastructure, and consuming-product teams. Engine teams retain detection logic; consuming teams retain their product workflows and acceptance criteria; workflow and Quality Gate owners retain publication, policy, and merge decisions.

 Your direct customers are the technical teams building analysis engines, agent services, guidance capabilities, and other products on this service. Success is the value these teams deliver to developers and enterprises, not the number of shared capabilities shipped.

 What you will do 

 Set domain strategy and investment priorities. Shape a multi-year plan across customer value, dependencies, technical debt, adoption, and cost. Align senior leaders on trade-offs and recommend where to increase, redirect, or stop investment as evidence changes.

 Lead discovery with analysis-engine, agent-service, and consuming-product teams, and customers integrating through APIs. Use customer evidence and market and ecosystem signals to identify shared needs and opportunities for differentiation.

 Coordinate validation across ambiguous, interdependent initiatives. Prioritize the most consequential unknowns and use prototypes, pilots, and clear outcome measures to make timely continue, pivot, or stop decisions.

 Shape shared execution capabilities with engine and infrastructure teams, including input contracts, scheduling, dependencies, progress tracking, cancellation, retries, and resource budgets. Support different execution environments rather than require every engine to run in one place.

 Lead product discovery for issue-processing pipelines, including ingestion, normalization, correlation, deduplication, and tracking findings across code changes. Agree contracts for issue identity and state changes with engine and workflow owners, keeping processing separate from publication and policy decisions.

 Define how source context, findings, execution traces, proposed fixes, and verification results are stored, connected, discovered, and reused. Make freshness, provenance, coverage, and verification limits explicit so missing or incomplete checks are never treated as passes.

 Guide investments in shared APIs, events, extensibility, documentation, and integration paths. Reduce engine and consumer onboarding effort and enable independent delivery through stable, versioned contracts.

 Partner with engineering, infrastructure, and security on reliability, scalability, tenant isolation, access control, retention, and observability. Balance latency, coverage, compute and inference cost, and operational complexity.

 Sequence migrations and deprecations with engineering leaders while preserving existing workflows. Prove value through complete customer workflows before generalizing, and resolve cross-team dependencies without compromising reliability or compatibility.

 Shape launch, onboarding, and enablement for significant domain releases. Align consuming teams and customer-facing partners on documentation, operational support, and relevant pricing or packaging implications. Follow releases through to adoption and remove systemic barriers to value.

 Guide quality and launch criteria for shared agentic processing capabilities with engineering, AI special

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing solutions for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on. 
 
 As Senior Product Marketing Manager you will build a deep understanding of the end-to-end solutions (hardware and software) across all of Underwater Security (our OptiBarrier and OptiArray product lines and our software platform), and of the markets and customers they serve. You turn that understanding into clear positioning, compelling value propositions and go-to-market plans that help our sales teams win.
 
 Optics11 is in its scale-up phase, and product marketing in Underwater Security is starting from a basic level. You will build the product marketing function from the ground up: you set up the frameworks, processes and tools it needs, while delivering tangible commercial results along the way. You start as an individual contributor, with the opportunity to grow a small product marketing team over time.
 
 You will be part of the Product team in Underwater Security and work closely with our solutions Product Managers for hardware and software, Sales, Business Development, Marketing, Application Engineering, Customer Projects and R&D teams.
 
 No two weeks will look the same. You might analyze a competitor’s new seabed monitoring system, sharpen the value proposition for an anti-submarine warfare (ASW) tender, work on the launch of a new software release, train the sales team on a new product narrative, or help prepare a customer demo for a tradeshow such as UDT or Euronaval. You will own how our products are positioned, launched and sold in the market, support pricing decisions, and make sure your market insights support Optics11 product decision making.
 
 Within your first 6–12 months, you will have evolved the foundations of product marketing in Underwater Security: clearly defined target segments and buyer personas, a positioning and messaging framework per product line, a competitive intelligence baseline, a repeatable launch process and a first sales enablement toolkit. Your work will sharpen our market focus, improve our win rate and help Optics11 scale its solutions commercially in demanding, high-stakes markets. 
 
 Responsibilities:
 Build the product marketing function by setting up the frameworks, processes, templates and tools for positioning, launches, competitive intelligence, sales enablement and product marketing analytics, tracking pipeline contribution and win rates, and scaling them as the organization grows.

 Define target markets and commercialization plans by analyzing market size, trends, buying contexts and customer needs across mission profiles such as anti-submarine warfare (ASW), intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR) and critical underwater infrastructure (CUI) protection, prioritizing segments and use cases with Product Management and Business Development, and defining go-to-market approaches, channels and partnerships per segment (e.g. with prime contractors and system integrators).

 Lead competitive intelligence and market monitoring by tracking competitors, technologies, programs and tenders, running win/loss analyses, and sharing actionable insights with Product Management to shape strategy, roadmap and business cases.

 Own product positioning, messaging and value propositions by developing clear, differentiated propositions per product line and segment, and translating technical capabilities into operational and commercial value for defense partners and clients.

 Support Product Management on pricing and packaging by providing market, competitor and customer insights for pricing decisions on products and end-to-end solutions, and aligning price positioning with Sales.

 Plan and execute product launches by introducing a launch process scaled to the size of each release, coordinating launch readiness across Product, Sales and Support, and providing product messaging, content and launch input to the Marketing team.

 Enable sales and ensure commercial readiness by creating sales narratives, pitch decks, battlecards, objection handling and training, preparing customer demos, collateral and tender input with Tech Sales & Bid Management and Application Engineering, and supporting Sales, Business Development and Marketing in key opportunities, tenders and trade shows.

 
 
 
 Requirements:

 5+ years of experience in product marketing for technical B2B or B2G solutions, preferably combining hardware and software (platform) products in defense or another industrial high-tech / high-compliance environment with long, complex sales cycles such as tenders and partner-led sales.

jobs.title: Product Lead (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Product Lead (m/w/d) - Lern-Ökosysteme für Unternehmen, Bildungszentren und Verbände 
 80–100 % · Zürich · Festanstellung · per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung
 Über MaxBrain 
 MaxBrain AG wurde 2016 in der Schweiz gegründet und ist ein führender Anbieter für digitale Lernlösungen mit aktuell 12 Mitarbeitenden. Mit einer innovativen Kombination aus Learning Management System (LMS) und Learning Experience Plattform (LXP) übersetzt MaxBrain Lernstrategien in ganzheitliche, digitale Lern-Ökosysteme für Unternehmen, Bildungszentren und Verbände.
 Renommierte Bildungsinstitutionen sowie zukunftsorientierte Unternehmen vertrauen auf die Expertise von MaxBrain, darunter Bildungspartner wie Digicomp, WEKA und Talentus, führende Berufsverbände wie SwissAccounting, Electrosuisse und die OdA beider Basel sowie Marktführer wie Zweifel Chips & Snacks, InfoGuard, BLT Basellandschaft Transport und Baumann Koelliker und viele mehr.
 

 Worum es geht 
 Lernen ist für uns kein Pflichtprogramm. Lernen ist ein Motor für Entwicklung, Performance und Kultur.
 Unsere Vision: MaxBrain wird die People-Development-Plattform für mittelständische Unternehmen. Das Fundament steht: geschäftskritische Lern-Ökosysteme für Bildungsinstitute und Verbände. Darauf bauen wir auf. Künftig bildet MaxBrain nicht nur Lernmassnahmen ab, sondern auch die Prozesse, die bestimmen, wer was, wann und weshalb lernt: Skill Management, Performance Management, Compliance, Onboarding und Karrierepfade. KI ist dabei kein Zusatzmodul, sondern unterstützt in jedem Schritt: beim Finden passender Inhalte, beim Abgleich von Skills und bei Lernwegen, die sich automatisch anpassen.
 Deine Rolle: Als Product Lead machst du aus dieser Vision eine Strategie und aus der Strategie ein Produkt. Du trägst die strategische Produktverantwortung für die MaxBrain SaaS-Plattform. Du entwickelst sie konsequent vom Markt, von Kundenproblemen und vom wirtschaftlichen Nutzen her. Du setzt Prioritäten, reduzierst Komplexität und schaffst Klarheit.
 Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Entwicklungsteam in Kroatien und dem Team in Zürich zusammen, berichtest direkt an den CEO und hast die Perspektive, Teil der Geschäftsleitung zu werden.
 

 Deine Aufgaben 
 Produktvision und -strategie: Du entwickelst die Vision von MaxBrain als People-Development-Plattform weiter und übersetzt sie in eine klare Produktstrategie. Du legst fest, welche Probleme wir für welche Kunden lösen und welche nicht.

 Markt und Positionierung: Du kennst den L&D- und HR-Tech-Markt im DACH-Raum. Du beobachtest Wettbewerb und Trends und schärfst gemeinsam mit dem CEO unsere Positionierung.

 Fokussierte Roadmap: Du leitest aus Strategie und Kundenbedürfnissen eine nutzenorientierte Roadmap ab. Du setzt klare Prioritäten und sagst auch Nein. Du reduzierst Komplexität, statt Feature-Listen zu verwalten.

jobs.title: Junior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Introductie 
 Ben jij analytisch sterk, commercieel ingesteld en heb je affiniteit met techniek en productmanagement? Weet jij marktontwikkelingen te vertalen naar kansen voor producten en diensten? En krijg jij energie van het optimaliseren van een productportfolio en het succesvol introduceren van nieuwe producten?
 Bij FAAC Technologies zoeken we een Junior Product Manager die verantwoordelijk wordt voor de positionering en ontwikkeling van ons productportfolio. In deze rol vorm je de verbindende schakel tussen Sales, Marketing, Techniek en de internationale productmanagementteams van FAAC Group. Door marktontwikkelingen te volgen en klantbehoeften te analyseren, zorg je ervoor dat onze producten aansluiten op de behoeften van de markt en de strategische doelstellingen van de organisatie.
 We zoeken iemand die aan het begin van zijn of haar carrière staat en zich verder wil ontwikkelen binnen productmanagement. Of je nu net bent afgestudeerd en klaar bent voor een eerste uitdaging, of al circa 1 tot 3 jaar werkervaring hebt opgedaan: enthousiasme, analytisch vermogen, commerciële interesse en de motivatie om je te ontwikkelen vinden we minstens zo belangrijk als ruime werkervaring.
 In deze veelzijdige hybride functie komen marktinzichten, commerciële analyses en technische kennis samen om onze producten en diensten continu te verbeteren. Je krijgt de ruimte om je kennis en ervaring verder uit te bouwen en te groeien in de rol. Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de Manager Techniek.
 
 Wat ga je doen / Taken en verantwoordelijkheden 
 Als Product Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor de positionering, ontwikkeling en optimalisatie van het productportfolio van FAAC Technologies. Marktbehoeften en productontwikkelingen vertaal je naar concrete verbeteringen. Daarnaast zorg je ervoor dat productinformatie, prijzen en communicatie actueel en consistent blijven.
 Analyseren van marktontwikkelingen en klantbehoeften om deze te vertalen naar het productaanbod

 Uitvoeren van prijsanalyses en afstemmen van de prijspositionering met internationale productafdelingen

 Volgen van productontwikkelingen en vertalen van relevante innovaties naar kansen voor de organisatie

 Afstemmen van productintroducties en de lancering van nieuwe diensten met betrokken teams binnen FAAC Group

 Begeleiden van processen rondom productintroducties en het uitfaseren van producten

 Analyseren en optimaliseren van het bestaande productportfolio

 Coördineren van technische producttrainingen en in kaart brengen van de opleidingsbehoefte binnen de organisatie

 Leveren van input voor productcommunicatie, waaronder online communicatie en marketingmateriaal

 Bewaken van de kwaliteit, volledigheid en consistentie van productinformatie

 Beheren en actualiseren van artikellijsten, prijslijsten en productdocumentatie

 Zorgen voor toegankelijke en actuele productinformatie voor interne afdelingen en andere betrokkenen

 Samenwerken met Sales, Marketing, Techniek, internationale productmanagementteams en klanten

 Naleven van de geldende HSE-richtlijnen en bijdragen aan een veilige werkomgeving
 

 Wat bieden wij 
 Bij FAAC Technologies werk je in een stabiele, internationaal opererende en technisch gedreven organisatie met een informele werksfeer en veel ruimte voor zelfstandigheid.
 Een salaris tussen € 4.359,45 en € 6.198,54 bruto per maand , afhankelijk van ervaring

 40 vrije dagen (27 vakantiedagen + 13 ADV-dagen)

 Een goede pensioenregeling via PME, het pensioenfonds voor de Metalektro 

 Een veelzijdige hybride functie op het snijvlak van techniek, commercie en productmanagement

 De mogelijkheid om bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling en positionering van een internationaal productportfolio

 Intensieve samenwerking met verschillende disciplines en internationale teams

 Een professionele werkomgeving met ruimte voor eigen initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling
 

 Over FAAC Technologie 
 FAAC Technologies, onderdeel van de wereldwijd opererende FAAC Group , is dé specialist in toegangsautomatisering. Van automatische deuren en poorten tot slagbomen en parkeersystemen – wij leveren innovatieve en veilige oplossingen. Bij FAAC werk je in een informele, technische en dynamische omgeving waar samenwerking en klantgerichtheid centraal staan.
 De FAAC Group omvat 32 bedrijven in 24 landen , met 18 fabrieken in 15 landen en 3 business units . Dankzij deze internationale schaal ontwikkelen en implementeren wij wereldwijd oplossingen voor personen- en voertuigenverkeer, met een sterke focus op kwaliteit, veiligheid en duurzaamheid.
 
 
 Wie ben jij 
 HBO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in een commerciële, technische of bedrijfskundige richting.

 Aan het begin van de carrière, met de ambitie om verder te groeien binnen productmanagement.

 Een starter of circa 1 tot 3 jaar relevante werkervaring, bijvoorbeeld in productmanagement, productmarketing, sales of een vergelijkbare functie.

 Affiniteit met technische producten en commerciële vraagst

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
The challenge 
An entrepreneur chasing an unpaid invoice in Lagos. A shop owner confirming a shipment in Guangzhou. A consultant navigating a bank's phone menu in London. For a growing share of Talk360's 6 million+ users, a call is how they get paid, keep a client or close a deal.
 These business customers choose us because we're cheaper than carrier and roaming rates, reach mobile, landline and company numbers, need no contract, and use one balance for every country. Today we serve them with a consumer app. Tomorrow we want to be the obvious way small businesses call the world.
 
 We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own and scale the Calling for Work product proposition from 1 to 100. There's no mature roadmap to inherit: you'll write it, test it with customers and scale what works, with our Product & Tech team, to deliver a step change in segment growth.
 
 What you’ll do 
 Own the product proposition: Set the vision, strategy, roadmap and targets for Calling for Work, and be responsible for its user growth and retention.

 Shape the business proposition: Define what Talk360's business offer is and how it's priced, together with our commercial teams.

 Learn from customers continuously: Use interviews, surveys, support tickets and app store reviews to turn pains into a ranked opportunity roadmap.

 Experiment fast: Ship small bets, A/B test the journeys that matter, observe real world behaviour and turn results into roadmap decisions.

 Lead delivery: Work in an agile Product & Tech team; keep scope tight, priorities clear and releases flowing.

 AI-native execution: Use AI across discovery, specs, analysis and prototyping, and help shape how the team builds with AI.

 Partner across the business: Work with Revenue, Marketing, Support and Data on go-to-market, acquisition, retention and the metrics that show we're winning.

 
 
 The Team 
 You'll join a lean Product & Engineering team where product, design, mobile, web, backend, VoIP and QA work closely together. No silos, no layers: turn a customer insight on Monday into a live experiment by Friday.
 
 What you’ll bring 
 5+ years in product management, including owning a product line or new proposition end to end.

 A track record of scaling a product from early traction, with commercial results to show.

 Hands-on experience with B2B, SMB or prosumer products; telecoms is a plus.

 Strong discovery skills: customer interviews, research synthesis and jobs-to-be-done thinking.

 Experimentation fluency: A/B testing, product analytics (Mixpanel or similar) and data analysis and data-driven decision making.

 Experience optimising MAU, ARPU, LTV, retention and conversion, with the business acumen to make strategic and tactical calls.

 Experience leading agile, cross-functional mobile product teams, with the technical depth to discuss trade-offs with engineers.

 Active, daily use of AI across your product workflow: research, analysis, specs and prototyping.

 
Who you are 
 Growth mindset: You're energised by building a playbook that doesn't exist yet.

 Ambitious and pragmatic: You aim for 100 but ship the smallest thing that proves the next step.

 Owner: You act without waiting for permission and own outcomes, not output.

 Customer-obsessed: You'd rather talk to five customers than debate one assumption.

 Clear communicator: You align engineers, leadership and partners around one simple story.

 Comfortable with ambiguity: You make good calls on imperfect data and kill what isn't working, even your own ideas.

 You're based in or moving to The Netherlands and can be in our office three days a week.

 
Recruitment process 
 First call: A short intro call with our recruiter.

 Hiring manager interview: A deep dive into your experience with our Head of Product.

 Case study: Present a practical Calling for Work challenge to the team at our office.

 Meet the CEO. 

 Reference check 

 Offer 

 
 What You Get 
 Competitive compensation 
 77,000 - 90,000 euros per year all-in gross

 Learning and growth 
 €1,500 annual personal development budget, plus access to company-wide training sessions to keep learning and evolving. 

 Time to recharge 
 25 vacation days 

 Option to swap two public holidays per year for days that better reflect your culture or beliefs 

 Recharge Fridays, unlocked when team targets are met (we’ll tell you more during the interview) 

 Work from anywhere 
 As a global and diverse team, we encourage you to work from another city or country for up to 2 weeks per year, gain fresh perspectives and spark new ideas. 

 A team you’ll actually want to be part of 
 Weekly team lunch every Thursday 

 Regular team moments and outings 

 An international and diverse team, with colleagues from the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine and beyond 

 Set up for success 
 Company laptop and all the tools you need to do your best work 

 Monthly phone allowance and commuting allowance

Je geeft richting aan het digitale fundament van Mijn Independer 2.0 en vertaalt complexe technische vraagstukken naar een heldere productvisie, duidelijke prioriteiten en concrete resultaten. Met jouw werk maak je veilige, betrouwbare en schaalbare klantinteracties mogelijk en creëer je de basis voor personalisatie, AI-oplossingen en toekomstige digitale dienstverlening. Zonder deze rol ontbreekt de technische basis waarop nieuwe klantfunctionaliteiten gebouwd worden.
 Concreet ga jij aan de slag met:

 li]:mb-1 [&>li::marker]:text-base [&>li::marker]:text-gray-900 dark:[&>li::marker]:text-gray-100"> Het bepalen en uitdragen van de productvisie voor het Digital Customer Platform.

Je werkt intensief samen met teams binnen Data & AI, Mijn Independer Frontend, Customer Experience, Architectuur en Security. Samen bouwen jullie aan de technische basis van Mijn Independer en ontwikkelen jullie oplossingen voor digitale identiteit, authenticatie, autorisaties, klantidentificatie, accountkoppelingen, personalisatie en AI-gedreven dienstverlening. Daarnaast werkt het team continu aan het verbeteren van stabiliteit, performance, developer experience en het verminderen van technische schuld.

 Wat wij zoeken
 Je voelt je thuis in een complexe platformomgeving en weet technologie, business en klantwaarde met elkaar te verbinden. Daarnaast breng je het volgende mee:
 li]:mb-1 [&>li::marker]:text-base [&>li::marker]:text-gray-900 dark:[&>li::marker]:text-gray-100"> Minimaal 4 jaar ervaring als Product Owner of Product Manager.

 Ervaring met digitale platformen, SaaS-producten of klantplatformen en affiniteit met software-architectuur en technische vraagstukken.

 Ervaring met stakeholdermanagement binnen een complexe organisatie en een analytische, datagedreven manier van werken.

 Je begrijpt hoe moderne platformen, API's, identity-oplossingen en cloudomgevingen werken, zonder zelf developer te hoeven zijn.

 Je durft keuzes te maken, prioriteiten te stellen en strategische ambities te vertalen naar een heldere roadmap.

 Waarom juist Independer?
 In deze rol werk je aan de technische ruggengraat van één van de belangrijkste strategische initiatieven binnen Independer. De keuzes die jij maakt hebben directe invloed op de snelheid waarmee nieuwe klantfunctionaliteiten ontwikkeld worden, de veiligheid van klantgegevens en de mogelijkheden om AI, personalisatie en nieuwe dienstverlening succesvol in te zetten. Je werkt nauw samen met senior stakeholders uit Product, Data & AI, Technologie en Architectuur en levert een zichtbare bijdrage aan de toekomst van Mijn Independer.
 Het DNA van Independer kenmerkt zich door optimisme, klantgerichtheid en actief samenwerken. Dit zie je terug in een werkomgeving waar je volledig jezelf kunt zijn, zelf de regie hebt over je professionele ontwikkeling en alle vrijheid krijgt om je werk naar eigen inzicht uit te voeren.  Amsterdam - Lijkt het jou interessant om als product owner aan een applicatie voor miljoenen gebruikers te werken waarbij je grote invloed hebt op de architectuur en technische ontwikkelingen? Lees dan snel verder! 
 Wat ga je doen? 
 Als Product Owner bij Reclamefolder.nl ben je de operationele rechterhand van de Product Manager en zorg je ervoor dat het productteam altijd weet wat er gebouwd moet worden, waarom dat belangrijk is en hoe succes wordt gemeten. Je vertaalt inzichten uit klantgesprekken, data en gebruikersonderzoek naar concrete en uitvoerbare features. Zonder jouw regie ontstaat onduidelijkheid over prioriteiten, scope en requirements, waardoor de ontwikkeling van het platform vertraagt. Dit doe je onder andere door:

jobs.title: Senior Product Owner
jobs.description:
De backlog is niet het probleem. De vraag achter de vraag wel. 
 Een volle backlog is geen visie. Een roadmap is geen strategie. En een sprint review is geen impact. Als Senior Product Owner weet je dat. Je hebt de complexe omgevingen gezien, de politieke stakeholders, de systemen met twintig jaar technische schuld. Je bent niet op zoek naar een functie waarbij je uren vult. Je zoekt een omgeving die jou scherp houdt.
 
 De uitdaging 
 Bij LINKIT werk je als Senior Product Owner op opdracht bij organisaties waar de complexiteit hoog is: ministeries, grote corporates, data-intensieve omgevingen waar één verkeerde prioritering maanden vertraging oplevert. Jij bent de schakel tussen strategie en levering, tussen de directie die richting wil en het team dat die richting uitvoerbaar moet maken.
 
 Dat betekent in de praktijk dat je eindverantwoordelijk bent voor backlog, prioritering en roadmap, en dat je die verantwoordelijkheid neemt ook als stakeholders tegengestelde belangen hebben. Je vertaalt abstracte organisatiedoelen naar concrete productkeuzes. Je stuurt op waarde én op compliance, op snelheid én op continuïteit. En je laat teams en producten structureel beter achter dan je ze aantrof.
 
 Je gaat in dienst bij LINKIT en gaat op opdracht bij klanten in sectoren als overheid, finance en logistiek. De techniek, omgeving en prioriteiten van de omgevingen wisselen; de verwachting dat jij eigenaarschap pakt, niet.
 
 Jouw plek 
 Bij LINKIT werken we in squads, dit zijn onze expertise teams. Elke twee weken is er de clubdag: alle Explorers komen op vrijdag terug naar het hoofdkantoor in De Meern voor kennissessies, verdieping en verbinding. Tot 10% van je werktijd gaat naar leren en groeien, niet als bijzaak maar als onderdeel van hoe LINKIT werkt.
 
 Wat we vragen 
 Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als Product Owner in complexe IT-omgevingen.

 Aantoonbare Agile/Scrum ervaring; SAFe is een sterke pré.

 PSPO I en PSPO II certificering (aanvullende certificeringen zijn een pré).

 Ervaring binnen enterprise-organisaties, overheid of infra-omgevingen.

 Affiniteit met data-intensieve omgevingen en begrip van architectuur, integraties, migraties, security en compliance op hoofdlijnen.

 Afgeronde hbo-opleiding.

 Professionele beheersing van Nederlands en Engels.

 Voldoe je niet aan elk punt, maar wel nieuwsgierig? Dan komen we alsnog graag met je in contact.
 
 Wat je krijgt 
 Salaris tussen €6.000-€7.000 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis & ervaring) + 8% vakantiegeld.

 Jaarlijkse winstdeling en pensioenregeling.

 Hybride werken: op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, bij de klant of vanuit huis.

 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om tijdelijk vanuit het buitenland te werken.

 Elektrische leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding.

 Netto thuiswerkvergoeding, een goed ingerichte thuiswerkplek en een laptop en telefoon, die je ook privé kunt gebruiken.

 Om de twee weken op vrijdag komen alle collega's terug naar ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, dan investeren wij tot 10% van jouw werktijd in kennisdeling, leren en verbinden (dit noemen wij de clubdag).

 Extra's zoals onbeperkt opleidingsbudget, dagelijkse verse lunch, jaarlijks wintersport en wellbeing-activiteiten, , zoals een wijnproeverij en yoga.

 
 Sollicitatieprocedure 
 We willen je leren kennen, en jij ons. Daarom houden we het persoonlijk en concreet.
 Kennismaking: Een eerste gesprek over wie je bent, wat je drijft en of er een match is.

 Verdiepende gesprekken: Twee gesprekken over je ervaring, werkwijze en hoe jij past binnen de squad en bij onze klanten.

 Aanbieding: Als het klikt, volgt een concreet aanbod.

 Vragen vooraf? Neem contact op met Siënna via 
 Over LINKIT 
 LINKIT is opgericht in 1998 en gegroeid van IT-bemiddelaar naar kennisgedreven IT-organisatie, met ruim 250 Explorers uit meer dan 25 nationaliteiten. We werken voor grote organisaties in overheid, finance en logistiek als partner die meedenkt van vraagstuk tot oplossing. 
 Als Senior Product Owner werk je op opdracht bij onze klanten, met een contract bij LINKIT. Je bepaalt je eigen richting, met een ongelimiteerd opleidingsbudget en de ruimte om te groeien op een manier die bij jou past.
