jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Data & Platform (SaaS / Remote)
jobs.description:
Ready to own it, build it, and grow it? 
 
 The Mission: 
 Publitas turns retailers' static catalogs into interactive, shoppable digital experiences for brands across Europe and North America. We're a small, fully remote product organisation. 
 You'll be hands-on: in the codebase, in the data, prototyping with AI and shipping yourself. The default assumption is that you can figure it out, not that someone else will figure it out for you. 
 

 What you'll own 
 A product area with its own customers, roadmap and tech lead. You decide what gets built, in what order, and you carry the outcome. 

 Your first 90 days 
 Day 30 - You know your key stakeholders, have a baseline understanding of the product area and its challenges, and a working relationship with the team. You understand how the product is built and where the data lives well enough to form your own view, not one handed to you. A first version of the roadmap is on the table. 

 Day 60 - You've made your first major call - a scope cut, a kill, a bet - grounded in evidence and explicit about what would change your mind. You've found the gap between what was decided in your area and what actually ships, and closed at least one. You've put something real in front of customers or the team that you built yourself - a prototype, a working change - rather than waited for. 

 Day 90 - Your roadmap is trustworthy: Now, Next and Later are current and nobody has to ask what's happening. You've shipped your first prototype yourself, and your team is working AI-first. 

 
 
 What we need from you 
 Builder depth. You understand how software is built well enough to prototype against live services with AI tools, pull your own data, and ship without waiting for an engineer. 

 Evidence over summaries. You've made expensive go/no-go calls - a migration, a vendor choice, killing a product - from the evidence underneath, and you can explain what you decided, why, and what would have changed your mind. 

 Senior product experience. You've scaled a B2B product and know what that takes: the retention politics, the roadmap pressure from customer-facing teams, the trade-offs nobody wants to make. 

 Lived AI experience. You've shipped real work where AI did part of it and you can tell us exactly where it went wrong. You think in workflows and systems, not prompts. 

 Proactivity in an async team. You set priorities, make trade-offs, and decide what ships. 

 Excellent written English. We're fully remote and async-first; most of your influence travels in writing. 

 
 What We Offer You to Win 
 Compensation : Your salary is geo-bracketed to your location, with flexibility within the bracket based on your experience and what you bring to the role. A clear, performance-based path for progression follows from there.

 Real Ownership: Full autonomy over priorities, sequencing, and what ships within your pillars, plus the mandate to define how an entire product organization works with AI.

 True Remote Autonomy: No clock-watching or useless alignment meetings. You manage your territory as if it were your own business.

 Global Team Retreats: Working remotely shouldn't mean working isolated. We gather the entire company in inspiring cities across the globe once a year to connect, strategize, and celebrate in person.

 Modern Gear: A premium MacBook, remote work accessories, and a co-working budget if you want to work outside your home.

 Personal Growth Budget: A monthly wellness allowance, an education/course budget to sharpen your skills, and free access to Kindle and Audible books.

 Time Off: 25 days of paid vacation plus your local national holidays.

 
 At Publitas, we see AI as a core lever for performance, efficiency, and innovation. We expect all team members to actively use AI in their daily work to improve quality, speed, and output. 
 Depending on the role, this ranges from effectively using AI tools in day-to-day workflows to designing and scaling AI-driven systems. We are not looking for candidates who are "AI-curious"; we look for people who already use AI to do better work and can demonstrate tangible impact.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager - VPC
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

The Virtual Private Cloud team develops the core networking layer of Nebius AI Cloud.

We provide secure and isolated private networks, connectivity from cloud resources to internet and external networks, and networking services such as routing, security groups, load balancing and VPN connectivity.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive complex initiatives spanning VPC, adjacent cloud services, and infrastructure layers. These may include launching VPC in new regions, supporting new hardware generations, improving platform scalability and resilience, evolving service architecture, and delivering new customer-facing networking capabilities.

You will work closely with developers, engineering managers, technical leads and product managers of VPC and adjacent teams. You will turn broad product and technical objectives into executable programs, define outcomes and acceptance criteria, expose dependencies and trade-offs, facilitate timely decisions, and coordinate delivery through validation, rollout, and operational readiness.
 

Requirements

  1. 5+ years of experience in technical program management, technical project management, engineering management, or a senior technical role involving the delivery of complex cross-team initiatives.
  2. A strong technical background: you should be able to participate meaningfully in discussions about cloud networking and distributed systems, understand system boundaries and failure modes, and challenge assumptions without needing to be the primary architect.
  3. Practical knowledge of networking fundamentals such as IPv4 and IPv6 addressing, routing, network isolation, NAT, firewalls and load balancing. You should be comfortable learning and reasoning about the architecture of a production cloud-networking platform.
  4. Ability to communicate complex technical topics clearly, facilitate decisions, and produce concise, actionable documentation.
  5. Proven experience coordinating initiatives involving multiple engineering teams with different priorities and dependencies.
  6. Ability to structure ambiguous problems, identify critical paths, manage risks, and adapt plans as requirements change.

jobs.title: Lead Technical Product Manager, Rail Integrations (all genders)
jobs.description:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com .
 We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.
 
 We are looking for a Lead Technical Product Manager to join our Supply domain , more specifically in the Rail Integrations team, which is responsible for onboarding carriers onto our system (integrating external systems and harmonising data structures). This is key to scaling our business; therefore, our focus is on innovation and automation. 
 
 What you will do: 
 Lead and grow a team of Technical Product Managers and Integration Analysts, setting the standard for technical excellence and ownership. 

 Define the strategy for partner integrations — how the world's largest ground transportation marketplace integrates with operators across 70+ countries. 

 Turn integration into a competitive advantage by driving automation, slashing time-to-live, and building scalable infrastructure no competitor can match. 

 Own the roadmap end-to-end — make the tough prioritisation calls and deliver features that directly grow inventory and revenue. 

 Lead high-stakes carrier partnerships , engaging C-level stakeholders to scope and deliver integrations that unlock new markets. 

 Challenge the status quo — question existing processes and raise the bar for how integrations are scoped, executed, and measured. 
 

 Workplace: Berlin & Hybrid; or Remote
 We are a remote-first international company with team members spread around the world. We are looking to hire the best talent around the Globe, so wherever you are, feel free to reach out. If, however, you prefer working onsite/hybrid, our heart is in Berlin, one of the biggest and most vibrant tech hubs in Europe, and we are happy to assist with relocation.
 
 
 5+ years of product management experience , with at least 3 years focused on technical or API products. You've owned the full lifecycle of an integration product, not just supported it. 

 Deep technical fluency with APIs : comfortable reading documentation, working through data schema decisions with engineers, and spotting integration edge cases. 

 Experience scoping and delivering B2B integrations with external partners or enterprise clients, managing complexity across technical, commercial, and operational dimensions. 

 Fluent stakeholder communicator : translating complex technical concepts for executive stakeholders and engaging with equal depth on implementation detail with engineering teams. 

 Structured and delivery-oriented : you bring clarity to ambiguous scopes and drive execution with rigour. 

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 

 
 Nice to have: 
 Familiarity with ground transportation data standards (e.g. GTFS, NeTEx) or experience in travel tech, mobility, or logistics. 

 Ready to lead (experience a plus): you may have already managed a small team of technical PMs or analysts. If not, you're excited to start. You know how to coach, unblock, and grow people while staying close to the work. 

 Exposure to high-load, high-availability platform environments. 

 
 What you can expect: 
 Make a global impact. Help shape how millions of people discover and book ground transportation worldwide.

 Own your work. Take responsibility from day one and see the direct impact of your contributions.

 Build with the best tools. We move fast, continuously evolve our tech stack, and invest in modern, efficient solutions.

 Work with industry leaders. Our partners include Booking.com , Google Maps, Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF.

 Grow with exceptional people. Join an international team that will challenge, support, and inspire you every day.

 Work your way. Enjoy flexible and remote-friendly working options, relocation opportunities, and plenty of room to grow.

jobs.description:
About the role: What's in the Box

Are you passionate about turning operational challenges into practical technical solutions? Do you enjoy working across different locations, bringing people together and taking projects from initial concept through to on-site implementation?

As Senior Project Manager Engineering & Implementation (alle genders), you will play a key role in improving and developing the infrastructure and processes across our European Fulfilment Centre network. Rather than focusing on large-scale factory launches, you will lead targeted engineering and operational improvement projects, translating business needs into practical solutions that make our operations more efficient, scalable and reliable.

Working closely with local Operations teams, Finance, Procurement, external suppliers and our Automation specialists, you will take ownership of projects from initial assessment and solution design through procurement, coordination and on-site implementation.

This is an international, hands-on role with a strong operational focus. You will regularly travel to our Fulfilment Centres across Europe, including locations in Germany, the Netherlands and the Nordics, to understand local challenges, coordinate implementation activities and ensure that solutions work in practice.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

  • Lead engineering and improvement projects: Own targeted projects from initial scoping and requirements gathering through solution development, implementation and handover to local operations.
  • Design practical solutions: Develop and evaluate concepts for material flow, warehouse layouts, equipment and operational infrastructure, ensuring solutions meet local business needs.
  • Drive procurement and implementation: Coordinate direct and indirect procurement activities, including CAPEX projects, in close collaboration with local Finance teams, Procurement and our Amsterdam-based colleagues.
  • Make things happen on-site: Coordinate suppliers, contractors and local stakeholders to manage equipment delivery, installation, commissioning and implementation at our Fulfilment Centres.
  • Collaborate across functions: Work closely with Operations, Automation, IT Infrastructure, Tech, FSQA and Health & Safety to ensure smooth project execution.
  • Improve existing operations: Identify opportunities to optimize existing processes, equipment and material flows, translating operational challenges into tangible improvements.
  • Manage project delivery: Define timelines, milestones and deliverables, manage dependencies and proactively address risks and resource constraints.
  • Connect our international network: Build relationships across different Fulfilment Centres, understand local requirements and ensure knowledge sharing and consistency across locations.
  • Support operational teams: Provide hands-on support during implementation, troubleshooting and post-launch activities where needed.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

  • Experience in technical project management, engineering, operations, logistics, warehouse design or a comparable field.
  • A solid understanding of material flow, operational processes, industrial hardware or warehouse infrastructure.
  • Proven ability to independently manage projects, coordinate different stakeholders and drive implementation from concept to completion.
  • Experience working with suppliers, contractors or external service providers.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into practical solutions.
  • A hands-on, pragmatic mindset and the confidence to take ownership and make things happen in a fast-paced operational environment.
  • Willingness to travel internationally for up to 50% of your working time. Regular on-site presence at our European Fulfilment Centres is an essential part of the role.

  • Benefit from 30 days of paid vacation each year to rest and recharge.
  • Travel sustainably and affordably with a monthly Deutschlandticket subsidy.
  • Grow your skills through internal trainings, team-specific L&D resources, and a structured onboarding program.
  • Work in a modern environment with friendly, supportive co-workers, plus perks like a cafeteria, a Selgros wholesale card, and provided safety equipment.

jobs.title: Product Analytics Team Lead
jobs.description:
HEY THERE 
 You've spent the last few years as the analyst sitting alongside a mobile squad—close to the tracking, the experiments and the numbers behind their decisions. You've also been leading a small team as well for a while now, and you don't want to give up either half.
 Good, because this role doesn't ask you to. You'll lead our squad analysts, and you'll also be the hands-on analyst for Monetization. Roughly half your week in each role, at least at the start. Stepping up to lead here doesn't mean handing the interesting work to someone else.
 You'll be building solid data products, helping our Monetization team optimize conversion and revenue, but you'll also be responsible for ensuring that our product and engineering teams own the quality of the data they produce. Building this culture is a big part of what we're hiring for.
 Let's shape the future of nutrition together and make Yazio the most successful nutrition app worldwide!
 This role is 100% remote and open to candidates based in Germany, Spain, Portugal or the UK.
 
 YOUR MISSION 
 Our product generates billions of data points every month, and our development teams run hundreds of experiments a year. In your first year, you'll:
 Lead a small team of analysts embedded in our product squads. They're the ones measuring the impact of what engineering builds and helping figure out what comes next

 Be the analyst for Monetization yourself. You’ll handle tracking for new features, the experiments behind our conversion funnels and the reporting the squad runs on

 Set the example for how the work gets done. You'll write less production code than the analysts in your team, and the way you solve problems is what they'll pick up

 Set the data quality bar: what gets tested when data comes in, what gets tested once it's transformed, what gets tested in the reporting layer and what anomaly detection catches before a stakeholder spots it

 Move that responsibility upstream to the teams producing the data. Expect pushback from people who haven't had to think about it before

 Own the path from raw event data to curated, ready-to-use datasets in our self-service BI tool

 Take on the strategy side of squad analytics: how PMs and engineering managers use data when they make decisions

 
 YOUR PROFILE 
 You'll feel at home here if:
 You've been the analyst inside a mobile product squad. Event tracking, funnel and user journey analysis, experiments. You plan around release cycles and handle old app versions as a matter of course

 You've managed analysts without stepping away from the work yourself

 Experimentation is where you're strongest. You’ve run plenty of A/B tests, and you can talk through bandits, quasi-experiments and where Bayesian and frequentist approaches part ways

 You've built a data quality regime. You've held a number back because it didn't reconcile, then gone and fixed whatever let it through

 You write SQL all day and Python when you need it, and dbt is how you transform data

 When you take an analysis to a PM, it comes with what you'd do next. And when a number turns out to be wrong, you say so and change the process that produced it

 Bonus points for:
 Experience with subscription businesses, including the mobile gateway SDKs (App Store, Google Play)

 A strong statistics background

 Dagster or Airflow for scheduling

 Data catalogues like DataHub

  
 OUR CORE TECH STACK 
 Here's what we run in production:
 Warehouse: Snowflake

 Transformation & orchestration: dbt, Dagster

 Experimentation: GrowthBook

 Self-service analytics: Omni

 ML workflows: Prefect

 GenAI: Claude

 If you've worked with a cloud warehouse, dbt and an experimentation platform in some form, the patterns transfer. AI is part of how we work here: writing and checking code, summarizing data and keeping documentation current. We'd want you to be critical about what it gives back.
 
 WHY US? 
 An exciting product with millions of users in over 150 countries, driven by our mission to transform the world through healthy eating

 A remote-first setup: work 100% from home, join a co-working space, or work abroad for several weeks per year

 30 vacation days to relax and recharge, plus 5 child sick days if your little one needs you

 A focus-driven culture that values efficiency over long hours - no overtime expectations, and if it happens, you get that time back!

 A high-impact environment where your work drives real change - short decision-making processes and no micromanagement

 A team culture where ambition and balance go hand in hand, supported by strong connections - from our fully covered company retreat to team meetups and virtual coffee breaks

 Tools and support to do your best work: MacBook, monitor, and €1,000 annual learning budget, plus regular feedback and career development

 A truly international team with English as our company language and a shared commitment to growth and well-being - supported by Sunday Supplements and Nilo Health

 
 DIVERSI

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Core Experience
jobs.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. 
 n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.
 
 Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:
 
 Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

 Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

 Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation

 
That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register .
 
 We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.
 
 Your main goal will be to make building with n8n feel simple, powerful, and intuitive at every level, helping first-time users get to value quickly while enabling experienced builders to confidently create and run sophisticated workflows in production.
 
 To do so, you’ll own high-impact product areas across n8n’s Experience: from identifying the biggest builder problems to shaping strategy, shipping solutions, and continuously improving them based on real usage:
 
 Make the core building experience exceptional
 Identify and solve the highest-leverage problems across the workflow-building journey, making n8n easier to understand, faster to use, and more powerful as workflows grow in complexity.

 Turn technically complex capabilities into polished, intuitive product experiences through close collaboration with Design and Engineering.

 Continuously improve how users create, configure, debug, and evolve workflows, with a high bar for usability, performance, and reliability.

 
 Reduce friction from first workflow to production
 Find opportunities to dramatically shorten the path from an idea to a working workflow, particularly around setup, configuration, connectivity, and access to external services.

 Shape experiences that make capabilities such as AI models, web search, integrations, and other services immediately useful while handling underlying complexity elegantly.

 Balance simplicity with transparency and control so streamlined experiences continue to work for advanced, business-critical, and production use cases.

 
 Shape the foundations of a powerful builder platform
 Define product experiences and platform capabilities that make n8n flexible and extensible without exposing unnecessary complexity to users.

 Improve how builders interact with integrations, data, credentials, schemas, reusable capabilities, and emerging standards such as MCP.

 Partner with Engineering and developer-facing teams to ensure the product scales across an expanding ecosystem of services, use cases, and technical users.

 
 Drive product outcomes through discovery, data, and leadership
 Engage deeply with customers, community members, and internal teams to understand real workflows, pain points, and opportunities across the builder experience.

 Define clear product bets, success metrics, and priorities, combining quantitative evidence with strong product judgment and fast learning loops.

 Lead cross-functional teams across Engineering, Design, Data, DevRel, Docs, PMM, Support, and Customer Success through clear decisions, strong communication, and ownership of outcomes.

 
 REQUIREMENTS
 
 Must-haves 
 Proven product management experience: You’ve shipped impactful software products in fast-moving environments and can clearly explain the outcomes, decisions, and tradeoffs you owned.

 Builder mindset: You’re entrepreneurial and hands-on, and you enjoy moving from an ambiguous problem to a prototype, shipped product, and iteration quickly.

 Excellent product & UX judgment: You’re known for simplifying complexity and have a strong instinct for what makes technical products intuitive, polished, and enjoyable to use.

 Technical fluency: You’re comfortable reasoning about APIs, integrations, authentication, schemas, data flows, and system constraints and can partner deeply with engineers.

 Strong product discovery skills: You get close to users, uncover the underlying problem behind feature requests, validate assumptions, and turn insights into focused product decisions.

 Data fluency: You can define meaningful success metrics, investigate product behaviour and funnels, and combine quantitative evidence with qualitative insight and product intuition

The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. 
 n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

 We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.
 We're looking for an experienced design manager to lead our Product Design team.
 This is a management role. Your job is to develop designers, raise the quality of the work, and make sure design has real influence on where the product goes. It is not a player-coach role, and it is not a step up for a strong IC looking for their first management position. We need someone who has already managed product designers and can do it well from day one.
 n8n is a powerful, flexible technical tool, which means the problems your team tackles are complex. Design decisions have to account for diverse user workflows, technical constraints, and how changes ripple across the whole platform. You'll need enough craft depth to recognise excellent work, challenge it constructively, and help designers get better. The team needs a manager whose design judgment they trust.
 You'll manage a team spanning product designers, design engineers and user researchers at a range of seniority levels, working across our product areas. You'll work alongside our other design manager. You'll report to our VP of Product until our Head of Design joins the team. That search is running now.
 More than 80% of workflows built on n8n involve AI agents, and we're widening from a developer audience to a broader set of builders. That shift is the central design problem here, and your team is at the centre of it.
 🎯 Your main goal is to build a Product Design team that consistently produces excellent work and shapes how n8n's product evolves. Here's what that involves:
 
Lead and develop the team
 Run regular, high-quality 1:1s and coach designers, design engineers and researchers across different levels.

 Own performance management: evidence-based reviews, honest feedback, and real support for anyone who isn't where they need to be.

 Help people understand what's expected at their level and what growth looks like, evolving our progression framework for Product Design.

 Hire excellent designers as the team grows, and broaden the range of backgrounds and perspectives on the team.

 Raise the design bar
 Set and hold a high standard across problem framing, user understanding, interaction design, information architecture and visual craft.

 Facilitate design critiques and reviews that measurably improve the work, and help designers think beyond the feature in front of them.

 Develop designers' judgment and autonomy rather than becoming the final approval layer for every decision.

 Own the whole product experience
 Keep a holistic view across features and product areas, identifying inconsistencies, recurring UX problems, and opportunities for more coherent patterns.

 Work with the team to address fragmentation systematically rather than feature by feature.

 Make design a real partner
 Partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership so design contributes early to problem definition and product direction, not late to execution.

 Help designers influence product decisions through strong reasoning rather than positional authority.

 Improve how the team works across critique, collaboration, decision-making and knowledge sharing, introducing structure where it helps the team scale and resisting process that slows things down.

jobs.description:
Your Mission: 
 As (Senior) Project Manager – Industrialization (all genders), you will lead the delivery of our multi-year, large-scale EU-Innovation Fund project CAROLUS for the industrialisation of VÆRIDION's Microliner, including the set-up of our first Final Assembly Line at Oberpfaffenhofen Airport. Positioned within Programme Management and working closely with Finance, you will translate grant commitments into an integrated delivery plan and ensure that milestones, deliverables, and funding obligations are met on time, within budget, and in line with EU funding rules. You will coordinate activities across engineering, certification, operations, finance, and external partners, and act as the main point of contact for the funding authority. Depending on capacity, you will also support further EU and national grant projects, from proposal preparation through to day-to-day project management.
  
 Your Day-to-Day: 
 Lead our flagship industrialisation grant 
 Lead the end-to-end management of our CAROLUS grant project, from grant signature through industrialisation and entry into operation.

 Develop and maintain the integrated project plan, milestone schedule, and deliverable roadmap, aligned with the company's master schedule.

 Drive the completion of milestones and deliverables, ensuring that evidence is complete, consistent, and submitted on time.

 Establish and run project governance, including steering committee meetings, risk management, escalation, and change control processes.

 Coordinate engineering, certification, operations, and facility activities across internal teams and external stakeholders.

 Prepare periodic and annual reports, covering technical progress, emission reduction performance, and knowledge sharing.

 Act as the main point of contact for the funding authority, managing reporting obligations, communication, and grant amendments.

 Ensure compliance with funding, environmental, and visibility requirements, and maintain audit readiness throughout the project lifecycle.

 Support grant agreement preparation and the kick-off of newly awarded projects

 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.

 5+ years of project management experience.

 Proven track record of managing milestone-driven projects and reporting to senior management.

 Solid understanding of budgets, payment plans, and financial reporting.

 Knowledge of lump sum EU funding or German national funding programmes is a plus.

 Experience with project management and planning tools such as Microsoft Project, Jira, Smartsheet, or similar.

 Fluent in English; German is a plus.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Verve has created a more efficient and privacy-focused way to buy and monetize advertising. Verve is an ecosystem of demand and supply technologies fusing data, media, and technology together to deliver results and growth to both advertisers and publishers–no matter the screen or location, no matter who, what, or where a customer is. With offices across the globe and with an eye on servicing forward-thinking advertising customers, Verve’s solutions are trusted by more than 90 of the United States’ top 100 advertisers, 4,000 publishers globally, and the world’s top demand-side platforms. Learn more at verve.com.

Who You Are

We are currently seeking a Senior Product Manager to own our Identity Graph / Enrichment & Audience Enhancement products. You will lead an already established Identity & Audience team to grow Verve's presence in the AdTech space through the innovative execution of key strategic initiatives. The successful candidate will participate in the development of the product strategy and product roadmaps, leading product initiatives end-to-end from ideation to launch and go-to-market. They will inform product requirements, collaborate with engineering on implementation, take products to market through extensive A/B testing & experimentation, and be responsible for commercial success.

What You Will Do

  • Grow our Identity Graph / Enrichment & Audience Enhancement products' impact based on the data-driven insights that shape your roadmap
  • Ensure the product increments we build are aligned with the overall strategy and product vision
  • Own and lead product development end-to-end from discovery to launch to iteration
  • Come up with hypotheses, run experiments, and holdout tests to quantify the incremental value of identity and audience features.
  • Collaborate daily with engineering, data, and product teams
  • Keep building the knowledge of the market landscape, including the needs of publishers, advertisers, and DSPs
  • Handle communication with internal/external stakeholders & partners 
  • Understand and map out cross-product dependencies with the other business units 
  • Set and monitor product KPIs to make sure the initiatives are driving product & business success

What You Will Bring

  • 5+ years of professional experience in product management roles, at least 2+ years of product management experience in the AdTech industry
  • Problem solver - You can capture business problems, come up with solutions, and write good product requirement documents to keep everyone aligned on the scope
  • Technically skilled - You have a good understanding of databases, data structures, and how software systems can be integrated and exchange data with each other
  • Self-starter & self-motivator - you don’t wait to be told what needs to be done; you take full ownership of product initiatives
  • Collaborator & communicator - you can gather tech and business stakeholders across functions & levels around you to work towards a common goal, speaking their language
  • Achiever - You focus on outcomes & prefer to have something done rather than have it perfect; you value an iterative process
  • Data-driven - you value the power of data and can perform data analysis to make decisions / assess results based on metrics

What We Offer

Just a few of the benefits waiting for you at Verve: 

  • Recharge with 3 Wellness Days throughout the year, in addition to your annual vacation and public holidays
  • Support your mental well-being with our Workplace Mental Health Solution
  • Boost your professional knowledge with our annual training budget & internal webinars, and level up your language skills through our German/English classes
  • Strengthen team connections while exploring new cultures through our monthly Work&Travel raffle, offering a chance to work from one of our global offices (after 2 years of employment)
  • … and even more reasons to join us!

jobs.description:
🧡 About Alma

At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well‑balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place - serving merchants and consumers.

Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience - without encouraging bad debt.

As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered over +25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers.

With 380+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!

👐 About the team

The Integrations squad is part of Alma’s Merchant Tribe and owns the API, SDK, CMS, PSP and custom integration ecosystem. The role reports to Khadija, the Group Product Manager and collaborates with Revenue, Partnerships, Solutions Engineering, Engineering, Product Design, Risk, Compliance, Finance, Operations and other product squads.

This is a permanent position (CDI) based in Paris, with an ASAP target start date.

💼 About the job

  • Set and drive the Integrations and Partnerships product strategy, turning Alma’s APIs, SDKs, CMS, PSP and custom integrations into a scalable growth platform.
  • Prioritise and deliver a roadmap around merchant and partner outcomes, balancing transaction growth, integration speed, technical quality, enterprise requirements and reusable capabilities.
  • Lead discovery and end-to-end delivery of complex API, SDK and platform features, managing technical constraints, backward compatibility and developer experience.
  • Build strong product relationships with partners, support functional and technical discussions, and measure impact through adoption, time to integration, time to first payment, API reliability, authentication quality, version compatibility and platform coverage.

🧰 You will work with

  • Slack for day-to-day cross-functional communication
  • Notion for product documentation, briefs and roadmaps
  • Linear for backlog and delivery tracking
  • Figma for product design
  • Metabase and Looker for data analytics

🧩 About you

To succeed in this job

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience, including significant ownership of API products, developer tools or integration platforms.
  • Experience working on products involving API integrations, collaborating with technical teams to define and deliver integrations between different systems and services.
  • Understanding of API design and integration principles, including REST or GraphQL, webhooks and authentication methods such as OAuth and API keys.
  • Strong business mindset, analytical skills and communication abilities, with the drive to align technical and commercial stakeholders and move complex initiatives forward.

And it will be nice if you also

  • Have experience working with payment service providers or orchestrators such as Stripe or Adyen.
  • Have worked with e-commerce platforms, marketplaces or SaaS integration products.
  • Have experience in partnerships, or as an Engineer or Solutions Engineer working on API products.
  • Have experience with payment APIs, fintech integrations or complex payment ecosystems involving merchants, partners and PSPs.

Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience.

🧘 What’s in it for you

If you join, you will be able to grow and impact on:

  • Own a strategic product domain at the intersection of payments, APIs, partnerships and European growth.
  • Help make Alma effortless to integrate for merchants while expanding reach through high-value partners.
  • Work on complex, transversal initiatives with measurable impact on integration speed, reliability, adoption and transaction growth.

🤑 Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on 12 months
  • Profit-sharing and employee savings plan
  • Health insurance: 100% covered by Alma including family package
  • Disability insurance: 100% covered by Alma
  • Sport

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Rivia 
 Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital.
 Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated.
 Over the past two years, European and US based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In March 2026, Rivia raised its $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital.
 Rivia’s ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end.
  
 About the Product Team 
 You’ll be Rivia's first product hire, reporting to the CTO. Today, everything Product is owned by the Rivia founders and carried out Engineering. Your job is to take it over, build the function, and make shipping high quality products repeatable. As Rivia scales, there is a clear path to leading a PM team.
  
 The Role 
 As Senior Product Manager at Rivia, you own the path from idea to adopted feature. Driving alignment across Engineering, Client Solutions and founders to build products that have relevant impact, from customer discovery, mockups, specs, weekly refinement, launches, and measurement of KPIs.
 You’ll own several products across Rivia’s platform. This requires holistic understanding of market and customer needs for complex prioritisation decisions. To do that you’ll need to be deep in the details: talking to customers, experts, writing specs, monitoring usage, keeping delivery moving. You also build the product management function itself, with light processes (PRDs, documentation, releases, prioritization) that a future product team builds on, and you own product coherence: the principles that keep features consistent as the platform grows.
  
 What Excites You 
 Shipping products that help bring new therapies to market. Our customers entrust us with their patients, we take that very seriously.

 Working directly with customers, including clinical research and biotech teams running global clinical trials, to understand problems and turn them into delightful solutions.

 Defining product management foundation, from first principles, as the first product hire.

 Joining a team that already works AI-native: agentic features run in production on live trials, customers connect their own agents through the Rivia MCP, and much of the roadmap ahead is AI products. You work the same way, from AI-built mockups to agent-driven analysis.

  
 Responsibilities 
 Product Execution: Own the full product lifecycle for your scope: discovery, spec, delivery, and post-launch measurement.

 Drive Cross-Team Coordination: Align Engineering, Design,w and Clinical stakeholders to hit delivery deadlines. Work closely with GTM to synchronize assets and commercial readiness with each release.

 Channel Customers need: Run structured feedback loops with customers and internal stakeholders, ensuring their needs are prioritised and our products are usable, reliable and high quality.

 Oversee a Multi-Product Portfolio: Weigh competing priorities across the product line, deliberately direct your own attention and your teams' bandwidth, and make sure customers experience the products as one coherent whole.

 Own Product performance: Set KPIs and targets before building, measure feature health after launch, and make kill, iterate, or double-down calls on the data.

 AI-Powered Product Development: Use AI agents in your daily work, including AI-generated mockups to accelerate discovery, and identify where AI unlocks new value for clinical teams.

 Product Function Building: Set up light processes (PRDs, documentation, release process, prioritization) that the team actually follows.

  
 What Excites Us 
 7+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS with technical products

 You have been the first or sole PM at a B2B startup and built the product function around an engineer-led team

 Has taken at least one product from idea to production with demonstrable adoption

 Hands-on product analytics: built measurement from zero with Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar

 Has designed and run product processes (refinement, discovery, launches) that engineering teams actually kept

 AI-native way of working: uses AI agents in daily product work, with concrete examples

 Comfortable being the only product person: self-directed, builds the function while runnin

jobs.title: Product Lead - AI Stockbroking App
jobs.description:
About Doit 
 We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.
  
 We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.
  
 In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. 
  
 The Role 
 We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within Doit's AI Stockbroking App.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.
  
 What You'll Own 
 Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas.

 Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

 Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

 Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

 Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

 Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

 Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.

 
 What We're Looking For 
 Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

 Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

 Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

 Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

 Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

 Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

 Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.

 
 The Kind of Builder We Want 
 Can set direction and still go deep into details.

 Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

 Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

 Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

 Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.

 
 This Role Is Not For 
 Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

 People who cannot go deep into product details.

 Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

 Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

 People who need large teams before they can create progress.

 
 Location 
 This role is remote, but candidates must be based in the Netherlands . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in the Netherlands .
  
 Language 
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
  
 Interview Process 
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 1. Online assessment or practical task
 2. Role-specific interview
 3. CEO / final round
  
 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Product Manager II - Financial Crime Operations
jobs.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance 

 Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.
 
 The team 
 Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.
  
 Kraken's Compliance Operations teams, including the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU), investigations and enhanced due diligence, are the front line of how Kraken detects and responds to financial crime. The systems they run on sit within Core Services Product, alongside the engineering teams who build them. That covers alert ingestion, case management, investigator tooling and a growing set of automation and AI tools.
 
 This role owns the product for that investigation platform. That means how an alert is created, enriched, grouped and suppressed. How it becomes a case. How an investigator reaches and documents a decision. And how every step is evidenced to a regulator or auditor. You'll start with the FIU, where the workflows are most complex and the audit bar is highest, then extend the platform across Compliance Operations.
  
 The opportunity 
 Own the investigation-platform roadmap end to end. Sequence it and defend it, and re-sequence it when a regulator or the RCO raises a P0.

 Define "done" before build starts. Write phased deliverables and acceptance criteria that Compliance signs off, and hold the line when scope moves.

 Get requirements in before engineering starts. Build the intake between Compliance policy, monitoring rules and case management so that changes don't reach investigators before their workflows are ready.

 Understand the process before building. Reconcile policy and SOPs against what investigators actually do and what the system actually does. Know the difference between a process fix and a technical one, and say which requests are in scope for engineering.

 Understand the pipeline well enough to challenge it: ingestion, profile and transaction resolution, suppression and grouping logic, and reconciliation between vendor output and case management. Be able to walk an auditor through it with live examples.

 Make auditability a first-class requirement: audit trail, data lineage, evidence retention, reviewer attribution, change-management controls, and validation of filtering and suppression logic.

 Ship automation and AI into regulated workflows with controls that hold up in Compliance, IT and privacy audits. That means human-in-the-loop design, explainability and ongoing monitoring.

 Run the operating rhythm: a shared forum with engineering and adjacent product managers, a regular stakeholder update, and one delivery status that everyone reads the same way.

  
 What you bring 
 4+ years of product management, including 2+ years on financial-crime systems such as transaction monitoring, investigations, case management, KYC/EDD or sanctions screening.

 Working knowledge of how an AML programme is examined, including the questions regulators, internal audit and model validation ask about monitoring, filing and control systems.

 The technical fluency to go deep on data flows and system design with engineers, and to spot when a design won't meet the requirement.

 A track record of shipping internal tools or operational platforms that measurably changed how an operations team works.

 Clear, concise writing, from PRDs and phase plans to audit walkthroughs and executive updates.

 The judgement to tell a senior stakeholder a timeline isn't realistic because the requirements aren't written yet, and to keep the relationship intact.

  
  
 Nice to haves 
 Direct FIU experience, such as alert disposition, SAR/STR filing or leading investigators.

 Crypto or digital-asset experience, such as blockchain analytics, wallet-level transaction analysis or focal vs counterparty logic.

 Experience shipping AI or ML into a regulated investigative workflow, including the control design.

 Build-vs-buy and vendor evaluation for monitoring or case-management tooling.

 Experience with programmes that span jurisdictions (UK, EU/MiCA, US).

 Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

jobs.title: Agent Product Manager
jobs.description:
Competencies 
 You're part product manager, part builder, part engagement lead. You take a messy customer process and re-design for Pi to handle autonomously. You're technical enough to own the configuration yourself: you understand APIs, data flows, retrieval and authentication, and you use AI coding tools to extend what Pi does, with the judgement to know when a change makes sense and the discipline to test it before it ships. You're as comfortable running a requirements workshop with a commercial leadership team as you are debugging why Pi made a decision, and you care deeply about the outcome Pi delivers.
 More specifically, the people who do this well bring:
 You turn customer requirements into precise Pi configuration: instructions, data, guardrails and escalation paths

 You configure and fix things yourself, using AI tools to handle technical changes without waiting on engineering

 You test like it matters: you design the scenarios and simulations that define what good looks like, and you don't launch until Pi meets them

 You run engagements with energy and structure, keeping customers, timelines and stakeholders moving toward go-live

 You own the number: adoption, time saved, revenue retained, whatever the customer deployed Pi to deliver

 You are Product's voice from the field, turning what you see across customers into clear, prioritised feedback that makes Pi better

 You likely have at least 3 to 4 years of experience, and you're technically competent enough to configure, test and debug an AI agent yourself. That might come from:
 A recent role as a forward-deployed product manager or forward-deployed engineer

 Product management on a technical product

 Founding a company, or building hands-on with AI in a way you can show us

 More than your title, we care about curiosity, rigour and a bias to action.
 Trajectory 
 Pi is Planhat's customer agent: a single agent that can be configured to take on processes across the commercial lifecycle, from onboarding and adoption to renewal and expansion. 
 Agent Product Managers are the people who make Pi real for each customer. You join once the customer has signed, work directly with them to shape how Pi is configured for their processes, and extend it to new processes and teams. You run a small portfolio of customers, own a specialty commercial area and help shape how the team works. 
 Everything you learn feeds straight back to Product, so Pi gets better for every customer, and you work closely with Sales, CS, Product and Engineering so no context or momentum is lost.
 Imagine:
 Taking Pi live on a customer's renewals process in weeks, from the first requirements session through testing to launch

 Setting Pi up to run account management for a customer's long-tail accounts: monitoring health, preparing renewals and handling the outreach no human team has time for

 Reviewing a week of Pi's work for a customer, spotting where it falls short, and shipping the fix the same afternoon

 Extending Pi from one process to the next for the same customer, until it runs across their commercial lifecycle

 Turning a pattern you've seen across five customers into a capability Product builds into Pi for everyone

 In this role you will: 
 Run Pi deployments for a portfolio of customers, from kickoff to live and beyond

 Agree success metrics with each customer and report on the impact

 Help customer leaders decide where Pi goes next

 Train the teams who work alongside Pi so they use it and trust it

 Build the playbooks and templates that make each deployment faster

 Definition of Success 
 Success in this role is measured by what Pi delivers for your customers, and how much better it gets because of you.
 Your customers hit the targets they deployed Pi for

 Their leaders come back to you for what's next, and Pi expands into new processes and teams

 Product ships improvements to Pi that started with you

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Vinted Go
jobs.description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

Vinted Go is the delivery arm of Vinted, focused on developing products and solutions for seamless shipping and delivery across Europe and the US. Our delivery network includes more than 30,000 pick-up and drop-off (PUDO), thousands of delivery drivers and cutting-edge sorting tech. Our product portfolio spans mobile apps, IoT devices, and autonomous robots. We operate right where high-scale software meets physical hardware, storefront partner operations, and complex logistics.

In this high-visibility, high-impact role, you’ll join a dedicated cross-functional product team working in close partnership with Engineering, Product Design, Decision Science, Operations, and external partners, you’ll drive the product roadmap, lead discovery, and build scalable solutions that power physical operations across our network.

In this position, you’ll

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager - EMEA
jobs.description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration , enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

 Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. 
 
 About the Role: 
 Hi there! We're hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our Product Marketing team.
 We're a group that cares about getting the story right, not just getting it out the door. We work closely with product, sales, and demand gen, and we hold ourselves to a high bar because our work directly shapes how the market understands what we build.
 This role gives you real ownership. You'll shape positioning and messaging for a meaningful piece of our product portfolio, build the competitive intelligence that keeps our field teams sharp, and work directly with sales leaders who depend on your materials to close deals. It's a role with visible impact, not one where your work disappears into a shared drive.
 As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you'll drive go-to-market strategy for your area, from positioning through launch through enablement, while partnering with product and sales to make sure the message actually lands. This role matters because clear, credible product marketing is what turns a strong platform into a business result. Camunda operates in a technical, complex space, and getting that translation right is not optional.
 What You Will Do 
 Own positioning and messaging for your product area, translating technical capability into a clear value proposition for both technical and business buyers.

 Build and maintain a competitive intelligence program that sales actually uses, not just battlecards that sit in a folder.

 Lead go-to-market execution for launches in your area, coordinating across product, sales, and demand gen so the message is consistent everywhere it shows up.

 Arm the field with content that works in real conversations: pitch decks, demos, solution briefs, and objection handling.

 Use market and customer research to inform product and positioning decisions, not just to validate ones already made.

 Mentor and support other marketers on your team, sharing what you've learned without being asked.

 What You Will Bring to the Role 
 Significant experience in B2B product marketing, ideally in enterprise software, with a track record of owning positioning and messaging end to end, not just contributing pieces of it.

 A real competitive intelligence practice under your belt. You've built and maintained a program that sales relied on, not just responded to research requests as they came in.

 Comfort marketing technical products to technical buyers. You can go deep enough into a technical concept to be credible with a developer, and simplify it enough to be clear to an executive.

 Field enablement experience at scale. You've built programs that changed how a sales team talked about a product, and you know how to tell if it worked.

 Strong cross-functional instincts. You know how to build trust with product and sales without relying on authority, and how to bring people along on a positioning decision rather than just announcing it.

 Comfort using AI tools in your day to day work. This isn't a checkbox, it's part of how the role actually operates.

 Create a culture of high standards and honest feedback, where people feel supported to do their best work and have a clear sense of what great looks like.

 Own hiring and headcount planning for the department, and help us grow without losing what makes the team good.

 Build research into how we make decisions

 Make customer insight, product data, and community feedback a live input to product decisions, so teams are building from evidence at every step.

 Connect research to the decisions that matter most: activation, adoption, retention, and helping new users find their way into n8n with confidence.

 Help the team work in new ways

 Help the team stay curious and current as the tools, patterns, and expectations around AI products continue to evolve fast.

jobs.description:
Finance Deserves Better
 Finance teams at fast-growing companies run global, real-time businesses on a patchwork of legacy ERPs and point solutions. Every new entity, project or tool adds another system to stitch together and another hire to keep the numbers reconciled.
 Light gives them a way out. We build the finance solution that lets finance teams have it all, through three parts that work as one:
 Our ledger records every transaction across every entity in real time, so the numbers hold up from day one.

 Our apps adapt Light to how each business runs, from procurement to billing to reporting.

 Our agents operate the repetitive work that used to need another hire, so finance teams spend their time on the decisions that matter.

 Today we run the finance function for companies like Lovable, Legora and Keyshot, with backing from Atomico, Balderton, Seedcamp, Cherry and Entrée. Now we’re taking Light into specific industries, with the ambition of becoming the operating layer each one runs on. Energy and defence sit among our priority sectors.
 
 The Role
 We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager to go deep on energy and defence and work out how Light wins there.
 Energy developers, operators and service businesses share a lot with defence technology and service suppliers. Both run on project and contract economics, both report across several entities, and both face long, multi-stakeholder buying cycles where auditability and approvals carry real weight. Your job is to understand these buyers better than anyone at Light, turn what you learn into positioning and proof our sales team can use, and build the playbook we follow to scale our go-to-market across both sectors.
 You’ll sit in our product marketing team and work side by side with the Sales Managers who cover these sectors, with support from demand generation, field marketing and product.
 
 What You’ll Be Doing
 Interviewing customers, prospects and specialist partners to learn how energy and defence businesses buy, what makes them change and where their finance workflows break.

 Mapping the market with Sales: which segments we go after first, which we test, and which we leave for later.

 Turning what you learn into positioning, messaging and competitive arguments that hold up in front of a project director or a CFO.

 Building the sales kit, from customer stories and demo narratives to objection handling and one-pagers, so our reps speak each sector’s language.

 Training sales reps and SDRs on the buyers, procurement cycles, contract structures and regulatory context of each segment, and joining customer calls to hear what lands.

 Bringing the sectors’ requirements back to Product, from project and contract economics to cash visibility, evidence trails and integrations with operational systems, and separating the needs that recur from the one-off requests.

 Giving demand generation and field marketing the insight, content and angles they need for sector campaigns and events, and tracking what turns into pipeline.

 Writing down what works, so the next sector we enter starts from a playbook rather than a blank page.

 
 What We Think* You’ll Need
 Product marketing experience at a B2B SaaS company, with a track record of taking a product or segment from insight to launch to sales adoption.

 A habit of talking to customers, and the judgement to turn interviews into clear positioning.

 Experience in energy, defence, infrastructure, industrials or another complex B2B sector helps. Curiosity and the speed to earn credibility with technical buyers matter more.

 Strong writing, from a sharp one-pager to a customer story people want to share.

 Comfort working with Sales every day, and a feel for what helps a rep win a long, complex deal.

We are Kolibri Games - a mobile games developer from Berlin. We believe that with the best people, we can make games that players will enjoy for years to come.
 

 Our games have defined the idle genre, and bring enjoyment to hundreds of millions of players all around the world. This is possible due to the talented people who make us who we are. ‘Kolibris’, as we call ourselves, are on a mission to continue making great games and we're looking for new talent to join our team. We strive to offer you a fair recruitment process and a great candidate experience, as well as a friendly environment to work in, with plenty of opportunities to learn and grow.
 

 Senior Product Manager, LiveOps – Idle Bank Tycoon (f/m/d)

Our Lead Designer owns feature design and the macro economy. You and your team own the numbers behind it: you set the costs and rewards of every game element, in both soft and hard currency, and keep them well-tuned for as long as the game runs.
You’ll report to the Head of Game and work closely with the Producer and the Lead Designer. You’ll bring the right data into every conversation so the team can make good choices together.

 Keep a close eye on game metrics, dig into KPIs and recommend improvements that support long-term LTV. Get to know different player audiences and build segments with tailored balancing and offers

 Run A/B and multivariate tests on the economy, events and offers to improve retention, conversion and monetization while reducing friction

 Collaborate on KPI dashboards, and help us work out which tools and systems we need to build or improve so we can make the best in-game choices

 Study the economies and live operations of games in relevant subgenres, and share practical insights with senior stakeholders and the wider team

 Hands-on experience running a LiveOps / event calendar, from planning to performance review

 Hands-on experience with BI and experimentation tools (e.g. Looker, Amplitude), and turning complex data into clear, practical recommendations that grow revenue

 Strong communication skills and a collaborative way of working

 Desirable Skills 

 Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Google Play Console and App Store Connect

 Experience with economy design in hybrid monetization (IAP and Ads), ideally for idle or tycoon games

jobs.title: Senior AI Product Manager - Maât
jobs.description:
Our Mission ⚖️ 

 
 At Doctrine, we're building Europe's leading legal AI platform.

 Our belief? Law shouldn't be slowed down by repetitive tasks. It should be augmented by a specialised AI, designed to understand, analyse and produce legal reasoning at the highest standard.

 Our ambition? To help legal professionals work with greater reliability, efficiency and peace of mind, through a single, comprehensive and secure platform.

 Today, 27,000 legal professionals across five countries (France, Italy, Germany, Spain and Luxembourg) trust us to do just that.

 Our growth is guided by a clear approach: a global vision, grounded in a deep understanding of local specificities.

 Behind this ambition, a team of around 250 people, united around one goal: supporting lawyers and legal professionals at every stage of their work, from research to drafting.

 And we're just getting started.

 

 
 Context 

 AI is transforming the legal industry, and the coming years will therefore be decisive in shaping the tools that will define access to the law.

jobs.title: Head of Product (H/F)
jobs.description:
Ta mission 🎯 

 

 En tant que Head of Product, tu seras amené·e à guider nos clients (Decathlon, Carrefour, SeLoger, Chanel, Deezer, ...) dans leur transformation Produit et l’amélioration de leurs pratiques, soit en immersion au sein des équipes, soit en tant que Coach ou expert Produit. 

 

 Tu seras également le Manager / la Manageuse d'une équipe chez Thiga pour faire d'eux·elles les meilleur·e·s consultant·e·s & Product People possibles ! 

 

 Tu auras pour mission de : 

 - coacher et accompagner des équipes Produit chez ton client pour les faire gagner en maturité Product Management par la mise en place et la diffusion de bonnes pratiques ; 

 - évaluer la maturité produit d’équipes en place et proposer un plan d’action approprié pour optimiser l’organisation et les processus Produit ; 

 - cadrer et lancer un nouveau produit ou challenger et améliorer un produit existant ; 

 - déployer une vision long terme et coordonner la réalisation concrète de la roadmap ; 

 - encadrer ton équipe de Thiguys·girls avec du temps dédié pour permettre à tout Thiguy·girl d’être dans les meilleures conditions pour son développement professionnel et s’assurer de son épanouissement. 

 Compétences métier 🖇 

 Tu as déjà managé et, après une période d’onboarding, tu accompagneras et encadreras ton équipe de consultant·e·s Thiga.

 Tu établis la stratégie et la vision produit.

 Tu définis la roadmap et planifies les futures versions de ton produit avec une stratégie user-centric, orientée problèmes et outcomes.

 Tu maîtrises le Design Thinking et le Lean Startup.

 Tu sais interpréter les KPI mesurant la performance de ton produit et en déduire l’impact sur les utilisateurs. 

 Tu peux accompagner ton équipe dans la définition de ses OKR.

 Tu collabores avec des Product Designers pour concevoir l’expérience utilisateur et créer les interfaces web ou mobile, tu sais préparer des tests utilisateurs.

 Tu connais et utilises des techniques de priorisations (Rice, MoSCow, Kano…).

 Tu es à l'aise sur le Product Delivery et l'ensemble des rituels Agiles.

 Compétences relationnelles 🎙 

 La communication : tu donnes de la visibilité et t’exprimes de manière synthétique en étant également à l’écoute des autres.

 La diplomatie : tu sais défendre tes idées et tes convictions & gérer les relations entre différentes parties prenantes. Tu sais faire preuve d’assertivité.

 La curiosité : tu t’informes des nouveautés et des meilleures pratiques en Product Management.

 L’humilité : tu sais te remettre en question et apprendre de tes erreurs pour mieux évoluer.

 Shameless : tu parles français couramment tout en ayant un bon niveau d’anglais même si quand tu prononces beer, bird, bear ou beard ça se termine en quiproquo 🍺 🐥 🐻 🧔🏻

 Expériences 📇 

 Idéalement, tu as minimum 6 ans d’expérience dans une structure Produit (avec de la Product Discovery comme du Product Delivery).

 Tu as déjà managé (en direct) et / ou tu justifies d’au moins une expérience de Product Leader (Head of Product, Lead PM,...) dans ton parcours.

 Nous offrons 🎊 

 Un On-boarding d'une semaine pour rencontrer tes collègues dont 3 jours de formation pour bien démarrer.

 Du confort avec deux jours de télétravail par semaine (selon le client) complétés par un accès à un catalogue de matériels, ainsi qu’un Macbook Air ou un PC selon ta préférence.

 Du fun avec des Thigapéros, des Squad-building et un séminaire (en prêtant attention à notre empreinte carbone).

 De l’apprentissage avec minimum 5 jours de formations à l’année et beaucoup de contenus pour te faire monter en compétences, notamment un programme de formation dédié aux Product Leaders avec des modules permettant de maîtriser toutes les facettes de ce rôle (coaching, OKR, organisation Produit, stratégie Produit).

 Et pleins d’autres avantages comme une carte Swile, le remboursement de ton abonnement de transport à 50%/forfait mobilité durable, etc.

 Les étapes 🎢 

 Un pré-entretien téléphonique avec un membre de l’équipe recrutement.

 On te rencontre en personne ou par visio avec un·e dirigeant·e de l'équipe Thiga (Associé, Partner ou Principal) pour valider tes acquis.

 Une étude de cas avec deux consultant·e·s du niveau Manager ou Principal afin de confirmer ce que tu sais mettre en pratique.

 Un dernier échange pour apprécier l’entente mutuelle 🤝

 Thiga accueille toutes les personnes compétentes et passionnées et s'engage en faveur de la diversité culturelle, l'égalité de genre et l'emploi des travailleurs handicapés — au contraire nous considérons la diversité comme une grande richesse !

jobs.description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION:
A career here is life-enhancing.
At Syner-G, we enable our people to build careers that impact positively on their quality of life. Through our expertise, insight, consulting and management skills, we accelerate breakthrough science and delivery of life-enhancing therapies to more patients. We work across a diverse range of clients and projects, supporting many organizations from the most critical phases of the drug discovery and approval process through to commercialization. It is meaningful, varied and thought-provoking work with a strategic emphasis, a solutions-driven approach and significant, real-world outcomes, from science to delivery/success. To learn more about who we are and what drives us, watch our company video here.
Underpinning this mission is a culture that aligns perfectly with what we want to achieve. We enable our people to grow, we support them in their learning and we reward them in so many different ways. In return, they play an instrumental role in maintaining our reputation across the globe as a strategic biopharma product development and delivery partner.
Syner-G was recently honored with BioSpace's prestigious "Best Places to Work" 2026 award, for the third consecutive year, along with many other award-winning programs to make a career here truly life-enhancing. These recognitions are a testament to our commitment to fostering a positive and engaging work environment for our employees, with a particular emphasis on culture, career growth and development opportunities, financial rewards, leadership and innovation.

jobs.title: Product Lead - AI Investing App
jobs.description:
About Doit 
 We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.
  
 We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.
  
 In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. 
  
 The Role 
 We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within Doit's AI Investing App.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.
  
 What You'll Own 
 Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas.

 Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

 Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

 Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

 Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

 Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

 Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.

 
 What We're Looking For 
 Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

 Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

 Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

 Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

 Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

 Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

 Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.

 
 The Kind of Builder We Want 
 Can set direction and still go deep into details.

 Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

 Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

 Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

 Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.

 
 This Role Is Not For 
 Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

 People who cannot go deep into product details.

 Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

 Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

 People who need large teams before they can create progress.

 
 Location 
 This role is remote, but candidates must be based in the Netherlands. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in the Netherlands. 
  
 Language 
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
  
 Interview Process 
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 1. Online assessment or practical task
 2. Role-specific interview
 3. CEO / final round
  
 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.
